items.title: 摩根士丹利發出最新警告：記憶體股低本益比恐為周期頂峰「估值陷阱」
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Issues New Warning: Low P/E Ratios in Memory Stocks May Signal a Cycle‑Peak Valuation Trap
paras: 在人工智慧(AI)強勁需求的推升下，全球記憶體晶片產業正經歷前所未有的超級周期。然而，摩根士丹利分析師 Shawn Kim 在近期研報《記憶體：周期與超級周期》(Memory – Cycles vs. Super Cycles)中發出警告，指出儘管 AI 驅動的榮景屬實，但「最容易賺的錢已經過去」。
報告特別提醒投資人，記憶體股票往往恰恰在周期頂峰時看起來最便宜，目前的低本益比恐怕隱含著危險的估值陷阱。

低本益比隱含風險

自 2025 年 9 月本輪周期啟動以來，亞洲記憶體股價已暴漲約 9 倍，市場對亞洲記憶體企業的每股盈餘(EPS)平均上修幅度高達 432%。目前三星電子與 SK 海力士預估本益比僅約 3.5 至 3.7 倍，美光(MU-US)約 6.1 倍，遠低於輝達(NVDA-US)的 17.8 倍與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)的 23 倍。
對此，Kim 測算，若要支撐當前股價繼續大幅上漲，DRAM 合約價需在現有水準上實現月率上漲約 70% 的極高門檻，這在現實中極難達成。相比之下，研調機構 TrendForce 預估 2026 年第四季傳統 DRAM 合約季增(QoQ)約 10% 至 15%。
摩根士丹利回顧 2008 年、2012 年與 2018 年的歷史數據警告，記憶體股價拐點通常會比企業盈餘頂峰提前 4 至 8 個月出現，市場習慣將高盈餘過度外推，導致本益比最低時反而最危險。

超級周期基本面強勁

儘管對股價前景趨於謹慎，報告並未否認當前強勁的基本面。三星電子在 2026 年第三季創下高達 800 億美元的營業利潤，刷新科技業歷史紀錄；高頻寬記憶體(HBM)市場規模預計於 2028 年翻三倍至 1,000 億美元。台灣廠商南亞科(2408-TW)9 月營收年率大增 576.62%。
然而，高額利潤促使各大晶圓廠大幅增加資本支出，預計 2026 年 DRAM 資本支出將年增 82% 至 980 億美元，2027 年更將進一步增至 1,500 億至 1,600 億美元。隨著中國記憶體廠商長鑫存儲(CXMT)與長江存儲(YMTC)快速擴產，以及新建產能預計於 2027 年下半年逐步釋放，產業供需失衡的局面恐被反轉。

摩根士丹利重塑投資優先順序

報告進一步分析，隨著 AI 資料中心規模擴大，硬體系統的價值分配正在發生變化。以輝達 NVL72 系統為例，當單機架擴展至 8 機架互聯時，記憶體佔系統價值的比重由 29% 降至 19%，而網路設備的比重則由 10% 提升至 20%。
基於此結構性轉移，Kim 建議將 AI 產業鏈的投資偏好重新排序為：AI 算力第一、網路設備第二、記憶體晶片第三，並對面臨成本高企與產能過剩風險的下游硬體持最保守態度。近期如 SK 海力士與三星股價單日重挫逾 8% 至 9%、日本鎧俠(Kioxia)較高點回檔約 58.6%，均顯示市場已開始重新評估周期風險。
paras_en: Driven by strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI), the global memory‑chip industry is undergoing an unprecedented super‑cycle. However, Morgan Stanley analyst Shawn Kim warned in a recent research note, “Memory: Cycles vs. Super Cycles,” that although the AI‑driven boom is real, “the easiest money has already been made.”
The report specifically cautions investors that memory stocks often appear cheapest precisely at the peak of a cycle, and today’s low price‑to‑earnings ratios may hide a dangerous valuation trap.

Low P/E risk Since the current cycle began in September 2025, Asian memory stocks have surged roughly nine‑fold, with the market revising earnings per share (EPS) forecasts for Asian memory firms upward by an average of 432%. Samsung and SK Hynix now project P/E ratios of only about 3.5‑3.7 times, while Micron (MU‑US) is around 6.1 times—far below Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) 17.8 times and TSMC’s (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) 23 times.

Kim estimates that to sustain the present steep price gains, DRAM contract prices would need to rise about 70% month‑over‑month from current levels—a threshold that is extremely hard to achieve in reality. By contrast, research firm TrendForce forecasts traditional DRAM contract quarterly growth of roughly 10%‑15% in Q4 2026.

Morgan Stanley reviewed historical data from 2008, 2012 and 2018 and warned that memory‑stock inflection points typically occur 4‑8 months before earnings peaks. The market’s habit of over‑projecting high earnings makes the lowest P/E ratios the most hazardous.

Super‑cycle fundamentals remain strong Despite a more cautious outlook for stock prices, the report does not deny the strong fundamentals. Samsung posted a record‑high operating profit of $80 billion in Q3 2026, a tech‑industry record; the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) market is expected to triple to $100 billion by 2028. Taiwan’s Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) saw September revenue jump 576.62% year‑over‑year.

However, the hefty profits are prompting wafer fabs to sharply increase capital spending, with DRAM capex projected to rise 82% to $98 billion in 2026 and further to $150‑$160 billion in 2027. Rapid expansion by China’s CXMT and YMTC, together with new capacity slated for gradual release in the second half of 2027, could reverse the current supply‑demand imbalance.

Morgan Stanley reshapes investment priorities The note further analyzes that as AI data‑center scale expands, the value allocation within hardware systems is shifting. Using Nvidia’s NVL72 system as an example, when a single rack scales to an eight‑rack interconnect, memory’s share of system value falls from 29% to 19%, while networking equipment’s share rises from 10% to 20%.

Based on this structural shift, Kim recommends re‑ranking AI‑industry‑chain investment preferences to: AI compute first, networking equipment second, memory chips third, and taking the most conservative stance toward downstream hardware facing high costs and overcapacity risks. Recent single‑day drops of over 8%‑9% in SK Hynix and Samsung shares, and Kioxia’s roughly 58.6% pullback from its highs, both signal the market is beginning to reassess cycle risks.

items.title: 《巴隆》解析輝達為何相對抗跌！AI債務疑慮引爆半導體股賣壓
items.title_en: Baron Analysis: Why Nvidia Is Relatively Resilient Amid AI Debt Concerns Sparking Semiconductor Stock Selling Pressure
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 週五（16日）股價雖然仍承受賣壓，但相較之下展現出一定韌性；與此同時，其他半導體類股持續遭到拋售，跌勢已演變成該產業十多年來最嚴重的賣壓之一。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達週四（15日）下跌 1.8% 後，週五盤前股價在平盤下方徘徊，此前一度上漲近 1%。自 10 月 6 日以來，輝達股價已下跌 9%。
追蹤半導體類股的安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 自 10 月 6 日以來已連續 8 個交易日下跌，創 2015 年 9 月以來最長連跌紀錄。週五開盤前，安碩半導體ETF下跌 0.4%，可能將連跌紀錄延長至 9 個交易日。盤中，安碩半導體ETF則下跌1.41%。
近幾日，隨著市場對 AI 擴建所需債務不斷增加的疑慮升高，進一步加劇半導體類股的跌勢，其中雲端運算業者 CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 尤其受到關注。
不過，輝達執行長黃仁勳週四表示，輝達不需要為 CoreWeave 提供財務擔保，緩解投資人疑慮，帶動輝達股價自當日低點反彈。輝達同時是 CoreWeave 的供應商、客戶與投資人。
週五盤前，輝達的反彈似乎有加速跡象，而截稿前，輝達週五盤中下跌0.50%。相較之下，同業超微半導體(AMD-US) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 盤前均下跌逾 1%。盤中，超微半導體下跌3.27%，英特爾則下跌2.06%。
針對輝達股價為何相對抗跌，《巴隆》指出其中一個原因可能是，經歷一段時間的持續下跌後，輝達股價對投資人而言已變得更具吸引力。
輝達是全球市值最高的上市公司，也是近年 AI 投資熱潮中最受青睞的股票之一，而技術指標也提供了相關線索。
在近期跌勢中，輝達股價於 10 月 6 日跌破 50 日與 200 日簡單移動平均線（SMA），此後大多時間都在這兩個傳統技術支撐水準下方徘徊。
週四交易期間，輝達股價一度跌至 213 美元，當時 50 日均線約為 220 美元，200 日均線則約為 224 美元。
黃仁勳發表談話後，股價反彈，與 50 日均線的差距明顯縮小，來到 217.23 美元，僅略低於 217.37 美元的 50 日均線。若反彈走勢延續至週五，技術指標將開始呈現更為看漲的訊號。
從基本面來看，黃仁勳的安撫性談話，很可能也讓原本擔心輝達在整體 AI 產業債務風險中所處位置的投資人稍感安心。
這或許足以支撐輝達自身股價，但黃仁勳能否進一步提振市場信心、帶動整個半導體產業止跌，並阻止賣壓持續擴大，仍有待觀察。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) saw its share price still under selling pressure on Friday (the 16th), but it showed a degree of resilience; at the same time, other semiconductor stocks continued to be sold off, with the decline becoming one of the worst in the sector in more than a decade.

According to Barron's, Nvidia fell 1.8% on Thursday (the 15th) and traded below the flat line in pre‑market trading on Friday after briefly rallying nearly 1%. Since October 6, Nvidia’s stock has dropped 9%.

The SOXX semiconductor ETF, which tracks semiconductor stocks, has fallen for eight consecutive trading days since October 6, setting the longest losing streak since September 2015. Ahead of Friday’s open, the ETF was down 0.4%, potentially extending the streak to nine days, and it fell 1.41% during the session.

In recent days, growing market worries about the mounting debt needed to expand AI capacity have further intensified the sell‑off in semiconductor stocks, with cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) drawing particular attention.

However, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said on Thursday that Nvidia does not need to provide financial guarantees for CoreWeave, easing investor concerns and prompting Nvidia’s shares to rebound from the day’s low. Nvidia is also a supplier, customer and investor in CoreWeave.

In pre‑market trading on Friday, Nvidia’s rebound appeared to accelerate, but by the time of publication the stock was down 0.50% during Friday’s session. By contrast, peers AMD (AMD-US) and Intel (INTC-US) were both down more than 1% in pre‑market trading, with AMD falling 3.27% and Intel 2.06% during the day.
Barron noted that one reason Nvidia’s stock is holding up better is that, after a prolonged decline, its price has become more attractive to investors.
Nvidia is the world’s largest‑valued public company and one of the most favored stocks in the recent AI investment boom, and technical indicators also provide clues.
During the recent decline, Nvidia’s price fell below its 50‑day and 200‑day simple moving averages on October 6 and has spent most of the time since then below these traditional support levels.
During Thursday’s trading, Nvidia’s price briefly dropped to $213, while the 50‑day moving average was around $220 and the 200‑day average about $224.

After Huang’s remarks, the stock rebounded, narrowing the gap to the 50‑day average to $217.23, just below the $217.37 50‑day line. If the rebound continues into Friday, the technical indicators could turn more bullish.
From a fundamentals perspective, Huang’s reassuring comments likely eased investors’ worries about Nvidia’s exposure to overall AI‑industry debt risk.

Whether this support is enough to sustain Nvidia’s own share price, and whether Huang can further boost market confidence, halt the broader semiconductor decline and curb the expanding sell pressure, remains to be seen.

items.title: iPhone Duo預購秒罄 首批現貨溢價2,9000元起
items.title_en: iPhone Duo pre‑orders sold out in seconds, first‑batch stock premium starts at 29,000 yuan
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊機16日（周五）晚開啟預購，起售價為人民幣（下同）15,999元，10月23日正式發售。
在蘋果預購開啟前，iPhone Duo就展現出超高市場熱度，京東平台的產品預約量已突破200萬，遠超同期常規旗艦機型預約。
據《藍鯨新聞》報導，有網友今晚在多平台搶購，進入購買頁面後顯示無法支付，頁面宕機數秒後，首批現貨便已售罄，約15分鐘後，購得的機子發貨日期已排到12月5日。
供需缺口帶動iPhone Duo在市場上出現明顯溢價，在得物上，iPhone Duo成交訂單超過700單，原本15,999元的256G版本，成交價高達2.19萬元。
另在其餘二手平台上，iPhone Duo也有不同程度溢價，整體溢價在6,000元（新台幣29,079元）至10,000元不等。
有黃牛表示，若果粉想在10月23日拿到iPhone Duo首批現貨，至少需加價6,000元。
不過，也有商家態度更為謹慎，稱該機行情尚未明朗，報價每日浮動，但可以確定的是，iPhone Duo會成為有史以來溢價最高的機型。
蘋果中國官網顯示，iPhone Duo提供四個容量版本，256GB售15,999元、512GB售17,999元、1TB售21,499元、2TB售26,499元。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched pre‑orders for its first foldable phone on the evening of the 16th (Friday) at a starting price of RMB 15,999, with official sales beginning on October 23.
Before pre‑orders opened, the iPhone Duo already showed huge market hype, with reservation orders on JD.com exceeding 2 million, far surpassing those for regular flagship models at the same time.

According to Blue Whale News, some netizens tried to buy on multiple platforms tonight; after entering the purchase page they saw a payment error, the page crashed for a few seconds and the first batch of stock sold out. About 15 minutes later, the delivery date for the phones they managed to purchase was pushed to December 5.

The supply‑demand gap has created a clear premium for the iPhone Duo in the market. On the DeWu platform, more than 700 orders were placed, and the 256 GB version that normally costs RMB 15,999 was sold for as much as RMB 21,900.
On other resale platforms, the iPhone Duo also carries varying premiums, overall ranging from RMB 6,000 (NT$29,079) to RMB 10,000.
Resellers say that if fans want to get the first‑batch stock on October 23, they will need to pay at least an extra RMB 6,000.

However, some merchants are more cautious, saying the market situation is still unclear and prices fluctuate daily, but it is certain that the iPhone Duo will become the most premium‑priced device in history.
Apple’s China website shows four storage options for the iPhone Duo: 256 GB at RMB 15,999; 512 GB at RMB 17,999; 1 TB at RMB 21,499; and 2 TB at RMB 26,499.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI疑慮壓抑晶片股、特斯拉撐盤 主要指數漲跌互現
paras: 美股周五(16日)開盤漲跌互現，本周朝收黑邁進。市場對人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮的疑慮持續壓抑半導體股，科技與AI相關類股本周走弱，讓投資人保持謹慎；特斯拉(TSLA-US)上漲則為大盤提供部分支撐。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近250點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近150點或0.6%，標普 500 指數跌0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近1.7%，台積電ADR跌近1.8%。
美股科技股歷經一周重挫後，股指期貨周五小幅走高，但投資人仍保持謹慎。市場同時消化資金撤出人工智慧(AI)交易、美債強勢反彈，以及通膨高於預期等變化，標普500指數期貨上漲0.1%，晶片股盤前持續承壓。
個股方面，特斯拉(TSLA-US)發表延宕多時的新款Roadster跑車後，盤前上漲3.5%；CoreWeave(CRWV-US)則因信用風險疑慮未消，再跌5%。歐洲Stoxx 600指數本周相對標普500的表現，可望創8月以來最大領先幅度。
美債殖利率周五恢復上行，10年期殖利率上升4個基點，但全周仍可望創2月以來最大降幅。美元料連續第二周走弱，布蘭特原油則在每桶106美元附近震盪。
隨著市場愈來愈擔心AI基礎建設成本，科技股本周遭遇沉重賣壓，那斯達克100指數自周一以來下跌3%，美債則重新獲得避險資金青睞。另一方面，高能源價格正向全球經濟傳導，使各國央行持續面臨收緊政策的壓力。
隆奧資產管理宏觀研究主管Florian Ielpo表示，經濟仍在擴張，但家庭與負債較高的企業正承受壓力，因此看好政府公債，股票投資則須更審慎篩選。
聯準會(Fed)主席華許在國際貨幣基金(IMF)年會對談中，未對近期政策方向表態。交易員隨後將10月升息押注降至約15%，回吐本周通膨數據高於預期後的部分升幅。
桑坦德資產管理的Francisco Simón認為，華許的語氣展現政策紀律，而非急於行動，重點在於持續關注通膨，同時避免反應過度。
Simón指出，企業財報將是下周市場的主要催化因素。投資人日益重視管理層展望，需要確認企業獲利前景仍足以支撐估值。Ielpo則表示，AI投資能否在目前融資成本下創造可觀報酬，是關鍵問題；油價對通膨與家庭購買力的影響也不容忽視。
亞洲方面，知情人士透露，中國正鼓勵企業與國有基金買進股票，並引導部分投資人減少賣出，以穩定股市。相關基準指數今年下跌約10%，周四收在2025年8月以來最低，北京當局力圖避免賣壓演變成惡性循環。
《彭博》宏觀策略師Skylar Montgomery Koning指出，即使本周重要經濟數據高於預期，美債殖利率仍下滑，顯示市場對AI熱潮明顯降溫的擔憂，可能蓋過供給衝擊引發的通膨風險，使債券重新發揮對沖股票風險的作用。

items.title: 川普怒批烏克蘭襲俄煉油廠「可恥」 歐盟力挺澤倫斯基
items.title_en: Trump Criticizes Ukraine’s Attack on Russian Refinery as “Shameful,” EU Backing Zelensky
paras: 歐洲聯盟領袖週五(16日)於高峰會上全力表達對烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基的支持，與此同時，美國總統川普則對烏克蘭發起新一輪抨擊，痛批烏軍攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠的行為簡直是「恥辱」。
歐盟於布魯塞爾接見澤倫斯基之際，烏克蘭正面臨戰局極為艱峻的時刻。除了飛機與無人機持續對烏國城市狂轟濫炸，基輔當局更擔憂美國恐將撤回情報共享與軍事援助。
川普上週突如其來宣布烏俄雙方已同意互不攻擊能源設施，令澤倫斯基措手不及。面對11月登場的美國期中選舉，川普指責烏克蘭襲擊俄國煉油廠推升能源價格，恐將重創其選情。
此外，美國已與俄羅斯達成柴油交易協議，此舉引發烏克蘭及歐洲盟友的強烈不滿。
澤倫斯基抵達峰會現場並與多位領袖擁抱致意時表示，他們希望能盡快結束這場戰爭，但目前並未看到俄方準備結束戰事的跡象，因此必須為即將到來的寒冬做足準備。
他強調，這份過冬援助方案不僅包含能源供應，更涵蓋防空系統與資金支援。
在最新一輪襲擊中，俄羅斯無人機轟炸哈爾科夫市造成三人死亡，其他地區的攻擊則導致數十萬戶家庭陷入停電窘境。
愛沙尼亞總理米哈爾（Kristen Michal）接受《路透》訪問時表示，歐盟可能必須向烏克蘭提供新一筆貸款，協助填補明年的預算缺口。
米哈爾說：「去年冬天已經宛如地獄，而今年冬天將再度成為一場噩夢。」
歐盟肩負著填補烏克蘭缺口的使命，因為人們必須被提醒，當大家坐在溫暖的房間裡、點著燈、開著暖氣並喝著熱咖啡時，絕對不能對烏克蘭戰爭感到疲憊，因為烏克蘭人正在為全歐洲而戰。

歐洲短期內無法取代星鏈

烏克蘭用於戰場通訊與無人機操作的SpaceX「星盾」（Starshield）衛星系統出現異常，令烏克蘭領導層深感不安。烏克蘭國防部一名消息人士周四表示，星盾接收器目前只能在移動時速不超過100英里（約160公里）的情況下運作，增加了執行軍事任務的難度。
一名美國官員否認川普曾下令刻意限制星盾運作。星盾是馬斯克旗下SpaceX所營運「星鏈」（Starlink）服務的軍用版本。川普本周也表示，美國仍持續與烏克蘭分享情報。
儘管歐洲各國政府與企業正著手研擬長期方案，但目前尚無可立即取代星鏈的選項。
歐盟外交與安全政策高級代表卡拉斯（Kaja Kallas）表示：「星鏈對烏克蘭確實不可或缺。遺憾的是，歐洲短期內無法取代這項能力。」
她補充：「我們正研擬新一輪制裁方案，向俄羅斯施壓，當然也希望與全球所有夥伴共同推動。」
澤倫斯基宣布基輔放棄川普所宣布的能源停火安排後，烏克蘭隨即攻擊一座俄羅斯煉油廠。
川普接受《Newsmax》訪問時說：「他所做的一切，只是在推高全球油價。我認為這很可恥。」
歐盟領袖抨擊美國購買俄羅斯柴油的協議之際，也正設法因應伊朗戰爭以來飆升的能源價格。這項議題在周四峰會首日便凸顯成員國之間的分歧。
澤倫斯基本月稍早向《路透》表示，烏克蘭已與歐洲夥伴敲定一項計畫，可填補今年270億美元的軍費缺口，讓烏克蘭得以訂購2027年初持續作戰所需的無人機。
不過，烏克蘭財政部長馬爾琴科（Sergii Marchenko）近日表示，明年預算仍有326億美元的缺口尚未獲得資金挹注，而且這還不包括盟友估計將直接提供的400億美元軍事物資。
荷蘭總理葉滕（Rob Jetten）表達了強烈不滿，坦言對願意承諾提供新一輪財政支持的國家數量感到失望；奧地利總理史托克（Christian Stocker）則抱持更為審慎懷疑的態度，呼籲在討論對烏克蘭做出新的重大財政承諾時審慎行事。
史托克表示，目前有太多數據在漫天飛舞，需要釐清脈絡並說明缺口來源，他對此同樣感到十分驚訝。
paras_en: EU leaders on Friday (16th) at the summit strongly expressed support for Ukrainian President Zelensky, while U.S. President Trump launched a new round of criticism of Ukraine, denouncing the Ukrainian military’s attack on a Russian refinery as a “shame.”

During the EU’s meeting with Zelensky in Brussels, Ukraine was facing an extremely harsh battlefield situation. In addition to continuous air and drone bombardments on Ukrainian cities, Kyiv authorities were also concerned that the United States might withdraw intelligence sharing and military aid.

Trump abruptly announced last week that the Ukraine and Russia had agreed to a mutual non‑attack on energy facilities, catching Zelensky off guard. Facing the U.S. midterm elections in November, Trump accused Ukraine of attacking a Russian refinery to raise energy prices, fearing it would severely damage his electoral prospects.
Moreover, the United States has reached a diesel trade agreement with Russia, which has sparked strong discontent from Ukraine and its European allies.

Zelensky arrived at the summit and, while hugging several leaders, said they hoped to end the war as soon as possible, but there was no sign that Russia was ready to end the conflict, so preparations for the coming winter were essential.
He emphasized that the winter aid package not only includes energy supplies but also covers air‑defence systems and financial support.
In the latest round of attacks, Russian drones bombed Kharkiv, killing three people, while attacks in other areas left tens of thousands of households without power.
Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal told Reuters that the EU may need to provide Ukraine with a new loan to fill next year’s budget gap.
Michal said, “Last winter was already hell, and this winter will become a nightmare again.”

The EU bears the mission of filling Ukraine’s gap, because people must be reminded that when everyone sits in a warm room, lights on, heating on, and drinks hot coffee, they should not grow weary of the war in Ukraine, because Ukrainians are fighting for all of Europe.

Ukraine’s Starshield satellite system used for battlefield communications and drone operations has malfunctioned, causing deep unease among Ukrainian leadership. A source from the Ukrainian Ministry of Defence said on Thursday that the Starshield receiver can only operate when moving at speeds below 100 miles (about 160 km/h), increasing the difficulty of carrying out military missions.

A U.S. official denied that Trump had ordered a deliberate restriction of Starshield operations. Starshield is the military version of SpaceX’s Starlink service. Trump also said this week that the United States continues to share intelligence with Ukraine.
Although European governments and businesses are working on long‑term solutions, there is currently no immediate replacement for Starlink.

EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas said, “Starlink is indeed indispensable for Ukraine. Unfortunately, Europe cannot replace this capability in the short term.”
She added, “We are developing a new round of sanctions to pressure Russia, and of course we also hope to promote this with all global partners.”
After Zelensky announced Kyiv’s abandonment of the energy ceasefire arrangement announced by Trump, Ukraine immediately attacked a Russian refinery.
Trump, in an interview with Newsmax, said, “All he does is push up global oil prices. I think that’s shameful.”

While EU leaders criticized the U.S. agreement to buy Russian diesel, they were also trying to respond to the soaring energy prices since the Iran war. This issue highlighted divisions among member states on the first day of the summit.

Earlier this month, Zelensky told Reuters that Ukraine had finalized a plan with European partners to fill a $27 billion military budget gap this year, allowing Ukraine to order the unmanned aerial vehicles needed for sustained operations in early 2027.

However, Ukrainian Finance Minister Sergii Marchenko recently said that next year’s budget still has a $32.6 billion gap that has not been funded, and this does not include the $40 billion in military supplies that allies estimate will be provided directly.

Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten expressed strong dissatisfaction, admitting disappointment at the number of countries willing to commit to a new round of financial support; Austrian Prime Minister Christian Stocker took a more cautious skeptical stance, urging careful action when discussing new major financial commitments to Ukraine.
Stocker said that there is currently too much data flying around, and the context and source of the gap need to be clarified, and he was equally surprised by this.

items.title: Photoshop訂閱還留得住？AI競爭讓Adobe遭分析師空前看淡
items.title_en: Can Photoshop Subscriptions Still Hold Up? AI Competition Leaves Adobe Facing Unprecedented Analyst Pessimism
paras: Adobe(ADBE-US)面臨AI競爭的疑慮持續升高，分析師對這家創意軟體大廠的看法降至歷來最悲觀。本周再有兩家券商調降評等，擔憂AI工具侵蝕Photoshop等產品需求，削弱長期成長動能。
富國證券周一將Adobe評等由「加碼」連降兩級至「減碼」，12個月目標價從270美元下修至225美元，使相當於「賣出」的評等增至七個，創歷史新高；2025年中時，這類評等仍為零。
分析師Michael Turrin表示，Adobe的成長前景正出現更明顯裂痕。他形容上月公布的第三季業績表現平淡，加上管理層近期表示將延後核心創意產品漲價，全年目標恐難達成。
匯豐分析師Stephen Bersey周二也將評等由「買進」降至「持有」，目標價從310美元降至267美元，直言Adobe確實可能受到AI顛覆。
今年以來，分析師已至少15次調降Adobe評等，使其反映買進、持有與賣出建議分布的綜合評分，降至滿分5分中的3.16分，創歷史新低，遠低於標普500軟體指數成分股平均的4.65分。
AI顛覆風險是今年軟體股的重要議題。年初，OpenAI與Anthropic等AI原生企業接連推出產品，引發軟體股廣泛賣壓。隨著投資人認為部分軟體仍難以取代，產業情緒大致回穩，Adobe卻是明顯例外。
Adobe今年股價已跌近30%，相較之下，追蹤軟體產業的iShares擴展科技軟體類股ETF(IGV-US)上漲3.7%。Adobe恐連續第三年跌逾20%，反映市場將其視為AI衝擊傳統軟體業的代表。
投資人擔心，使用者可能取消Photoshop訂閱，改以AI工具輸入提示詞生成影像。儘管Adobe也推出自家AI功能，競爭仍可能壓縮其定價能力與利潤率。
這也是匯豐降評的核心考量。Bersey指出，透過提示詞讓AI撰寫程式的「氛圍編碼」(Vibe Coding)，正催生功能仿照Adobe的新工具。他援引媒體報導稱，ArtCraft免費提供的軟體，涵蓋仿照Photoshop、Illustrator、Premiere、Lightroom、Acrobat、After Effects與InDesign的版本。
Bersey認為，這類競爭即使對使用者存在風險，仍可能因相關消息引發市場疑慮，持續對Adobe構成壓力。
paras_en: Adobe (ADBE-US) is facing rising concerns over AI competition, and analysts’ outlook for the creative‑software giant has dropped to its most pessimistic ever. This week two more brokerages cut their ratings, fearing AI tools will erode demand for Photoshop and other products and weaken long‑term growth momentum.

Wells Fargo Securities on Monday downgraded Adobe from an "overweight" to a "underweight" rating, cutting its 12‑month target price from $270 to $225, effectively raising the number of "sell" ratings to seven – a record high; by mid‑2025 the rating is expected to be zero.

Analyst Michael Turrin said Adobe’s growth outlook is showing a clearer crack. He described last month’s third‑quarter results as flat and noted that management’s recent decision to postpone price hikes on core creative products makes the full‑year target hard to achieve.
HSBC analyst Stephen Bersey on Tuesday also lowered his rating from "buy" to "hold" and cut the target price from $310 to $267, stating plainly that Adobe could indeed be disrupted by AI.

Since the start of the year analysts have cut Adobe’s rating at least 15 times, dragging its composite score – which reflects buy, hold and sell recommendations – down to 3.16 out of 5, a historic low and well below the S&P 500 software index average of 4.65.

AI disruption risk is a major theme for software stocks this year. Early in the year, AI‑native firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic rolled out products that sparked broad selling pressure in software equities. While investors have begun to see that some software remains hard to replace and sentiment has largely steadied, Adobe remains a clear outlier.

Adobe’s stock has fallen nearly 30% so far this year, whereas the iShares Expanded Tech‑Software ETF (IGV-US), which tracks the software sector, is up 3.7%. Adobe may see a third consecutive year of declines exceeding 20%, reflecting the market’s view of it as a poster child for AI’s impact on traditional software.

Investors worry users might cancel Photoshop subscriptions and switch to AI tools that generate images from text prompts. Even though Adobe has launched its own AI features, competition could still compress its pricing power and profit margins.

That concern is at the heart of HSBC’s downgrade. Bersey noted that AI‑generated "Vibe Coding" – using prompts to write code – is spawning new tools that mimic Adobe’s functionality. He cited media reports that the free ArtCraft software suite offers versions replicating Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, Lightroom, Acrobat, After Effects and InDesign.
Bersey believes that even if this competition poses a risk to users, related news can stir market unease and continue to pressure Adobe.

items.title: iPad Mini 8要來了？新款保護套曝光  傳將搭載OLED螢幕、強化防水
items.title_en: iPad Mini 8 Coming? New Case Leaked, Rumored to Feature OLED Screen and Enhanced Water Resistance
paras: 蘋果法國法規網站近日出現一款尚未正式發布的 iPad mini Smart Folio 保護套，型號為 A3632，與現有及過往 iPad mini 保護套的型號均不相同，引發外界對新一代 iPad mini 即將推出的猜測。
根據《MacRumors》報導，這款保護套似乎是蘋果近期新增至網站的產品，並與公司 9 月新增的 iPhone 18 Pro 配件一同列出。
不過，相關頁面並未透露新款 iPad mini 的規格，也未說明這款保護套的發布時間。
新款 Smart Folio 的出現，可能意味著下一代 iPad mini 的機身設計有所調整，因為這代表現有保護套未必能與新機相容。
市場傳聞指出，蘋果可能於 10 月 27 日或 28 日推出 iPad mini 8，新機預計配備 OLED 螢幕，並採用防水能力更佳的設計，同時亮相的產品還可能包括搭載 OLED 螢幕的 MacBook Pro。
報導認為，A3632 型號的 Smart Folio 可能就是為 OLED 版 iPad mini 所設計。
paras_en: Apple's French regulatory website recently displayed an as‑yet‑unreleased iPad mini Smart Folio case, model A3632, which differs from existing and past iPad mini case model numbers, sparking speculation that a new generation iPad mini is about to be launched.
According to MacRumors, the case appears to be a product Apple recently added to the site, listed together with the iPhone 18 Pro accessories that were added in September.
However, the page does not disclose the specifications of the new iPad mini, nor does it state when the case will be released.
The appearance of a new Smart Folio could indicate that the next‑generation iPad mini’s chassis design has changed, because the existing cases may not be compatible with the new device.

Market rumors suggest Apple may unveil the iPad mini 8 on October 27 or 28, with the new model expected to sport an OLED display and improved water‑resistance, and the same event could also introduce a MacBook Pro equipped with an OLED screen.
The report says the A3632‑named Smart Folio is likely designed for an OLED version of the iPad mini.

items.title: 告別百事時代！美國肯德基全面轉售可口可樂 40年合作落幕
items.title_en: Farewell to the Pepsi Era! KFC in the U.S. Switches Entirely to Coca‑Cola, Ending 40‑Year Partnership
paras: 明年肯德基迎來一項重大調整，一項延續40年的合作傳統即將畫上句號。
肯德基周四（15日）宣布，美國境內3,718家門市計劃將飲品供應商從百事可樂(PEP-US) 更換為可口可樂(KO-US) ，轉換工作將於2027年1月啟動，並在2027年春季前完成全部門市切換。
肯德基與百事的合作始於1986年。當時這家飲料巨頭大舉布局食品業務，收購了原名肯塔基炸雞的肯德基，同期收購標的還包括塔可鐘及必勝客。這筆收購落地後，原本供應可口可樂的肯德基門市，全部改售百事飲品。
1997年，百事可樂集團將食品業務分拆為獨立公司Tricon Global Restaurants；2002 年，Tricon正式更名為百勝集團（Yum! Brands）。
在這之後，肯德基的部分國際市場改為供應可口可樂產品，但其美國門市仍然一直堅持使用百事可樂的飲料。
如今，這項長達40年的合作終於宣告完結。
肯德基做出這一改變，旨在贏回美國食客的青睞。許多美國食客已經放棄了肯德基，轉而選擇Chick-fil-A、Popeyes等競爭對手。
美國肯德基總裁凱瑟琳・譚-吉萊斯皮（Catherine Tan-Gillespie）表示，此次供應商更換有助於公司未來發展。
「這次合作的意義，遠不止杯中飲料更迭。這是肯德基品牌升級又一步，我們藉此強化門市營運、調整菜單，為消費者打造更貼合需求的消費體驗。」 譚-吉萊斯皮稱，「可口可樂與我們對品牌未來有著共同願景，我十分期待雙方攜手創造的成果。」
對許多快餐連鎖店來說，飲料已成為吸引顧客的關鍵手段。包括麥當勞和塔可鐘在內多家餐館近年都豐富了飲品種類，推出諸如清爽飲品或「髒蘇打」（dirty soda）之類的選擇。
可口可樂在這方面似乎更具優勢，該公司今年早些時候曾強調，已幫助許多餐飲合作夥伴開發新飲品。
paras_en: Next year KFC will undergo a major adjustment as a 40‑year‑old partnership tradition comes to an end.

KFC announced on Thursday (the 15th) that its 3,718 U.S. locations will replace PepsiCo (PEP‑US) with Coca‑Cola (KO‑US) as the beverage supplier, with the switch starting in January 2027 and all stores converted by spring 2027.

KFC’s partnership with Pepsi began in 1986 when the beverage giant aggressively moved into the food business, acquiring Kentucky Fried Chicken (then known as KFC) along with Taco Bell and Pizza Hut. After the acquisition, KFC outlets that had been serving Coca‑Cola switched entirely to Pepsi drinks.
In 1997 PepsiCo spun off its food operations into an independent company called Tricon Global Restaurants; in 2002 Tricon officially renamed itself Yum! Brands.
After that, some international KFC markets switched to Coca‑Cola products, but U.S. restaurants continued to serve Pepsi exclusively.
Now this four‑decade‑long partnership is finally ending.
KFC says the change is meant to win back American diners, many of whom have abandoned the chain for rivals such as Chick‑fil‑A and Popeyes.
Catherine Tan‑Gillespie, president of KFC U.S., said the supplier switch supports the company’s future growth.

"The significance of this change goes far beyond swapping the drink in the cup. It’s another step in upgrading the KFC brand, allowing us to strengthen store operations, adjust the menu, and create a consumer experience that better meets demand," Tan‑Gillespie said. "Coca‑Cola shares our vision for the brand’s future, and I look forward to what we can achieve together."

For many fast‑food chains, beverages have become a key tool for attracting customers. In recent years, restaurants such as McDonald’s and Taco Bell have expanded their drink offerings, adding options like refreshing beverages and “dirty sodas."
Coca‑Cola appears to have an edge in this area; the company highlighted earlier this year that it has helped numerous restaurant partners develop new drinks.

items.title: 賴清德：台美關稅力保15％不疊加 301調查秉持台美貿易互惠
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te: Taiwan‑US Tariff Guarantees 15% Non‑Cumulative, 301 Investigation Upholds Mutual Trade Benefits
paras: 總統賴清德今(16)日接受網紅節目專訪，針對外界關切的台美對等關稅議題，賴清德回應，目前對等關稅雖對台灣有挑戰，但對也對台灣經濟增進跟美國產業結構，增加更進一步結合的機會，目前台灣與美國對等關稅15%不疊加，與日韓條件拉平。至於美方正進行的301調查，政府也會極力爭取原來雙方同意的談判條件，秉持台美貿易互惠關係。
游庭皓今日將與賴清德對談台灣經濟等專訪影片上傳，針對台美貿易、美國對等關稅政策部分。
賴清德說，台灣對美國的關稅談判，確實是因為台灣對美國的順差數字太大，以今(2026)年台灣的外銷金額估計達9,000億美元，其中最大外銷標的國為美國，預期台灣今(2026)年對美國的貿易順差，將會比去(2025)年美國提出對等關稅政策時還要高。
賴清德強調，美國對等關稅，固然對台灣是一個挑戰，但也是台灣增進跟美國，產業結構更進一步結合的機會，有望促進台灣產業的發展，包括台灣去美國投資，美方也會來台投資，包括科技產業、國防工業及其他產業也是如此，所以在雙方互惠的狀況之下，也能讓美國也看到台灣產業的實力。
賴清德說，目前貿易談判結果為對等關稅15%不疊加，雖然目前美國對等關稅的法源已經失效，但對台灣的關稅並未因此增加，目前政府會持續關注美方在301條款調查結果與最終稅率，極力爭取原來雙方同意的談判條件，未來仍視美國政治的局勢變化而定，但仍以台灣利益為出發點，不採取拖延的策略因應。
訪談最後，主持人也請賴清德預估台股未來走勢。賴清德回應，股市會到幾點，他並非專業，但他的工作就是經濟做好，目前主計總處已經把明(2027)年的經濟成長率估出來，數字不錯，相信經濟做好，股市也自然水漲船高。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te was interviewed by an internet celebrity program today (Oct. 16). Regarding the widely discussed issue of reciprocal tariffs between Taiwan and the United States, Lai said that while the reciprocal tariff poses challenges for Taiwan, it also offers opportunities to deepen Taiwan’s economic ties with the U.S. and align industrial structures. Currently the reciprocal tariff is set at 15% for Taiwan and is not stacked, putting it on par with the conditions applied to Japan and South Korea.
Yu Ting-hao will upload today a video interview with Lai Ching-te on Taiwan’s economy, focusing on Taiwan‑U.S. trade and the U.S. reciprocal‑tariff policy.

Lai explained that the tariff negotiations stem from Taiwan’s large trade surplus with the United States. In 2026 Taiwan’s total exports are estimated at US$900 billion, with the United States as the biggest export destination. He expects Taiwan’s 2026 trade surplus with the U.S. to be even higher than in 2025, when Washington first announced its reciprocal‑tariff measures.

Lai emphasized that although the U.S. reciprocal tariff is a challenge, it also creates a chance for deeper integration of Taiwan’s and U.S. industrial structures, potentially boosting Taiwan’s industry. He noted that Taiwanese investment in the United States will increase and that U.S. firms are expected to invest in Taiwan, especially in technology, defense, and other sectors, showcasing Taiwan’s industrial strength under a mutually beneficial framework.

Lai said the current trade‑negotiation outcome is a 15% reciprocal tariff that is not cumulative. Although the legal basis for the U.S. reciprocal tariff has expired, Taiwan’s tariff rates have not risen as a result. The government will continue to monitor the outcome of the U.S. Section 301 investigation and the final tariff rates, vigorously pursuing the originally agreed negotiation terms. Future actions will depend on U.S. political developments, but Taiwan’s interests remain the priority and no delay tactics will be employed.

At the end of the interview, the host asked Lai to forecast the Taiwan stock market’s direction. Lai replied that he is not a market professional, but his job is to ensure a sound economy. He noted that the Directorate General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics has projected a solid 2027 economic growth rate, and he believes that a strong economy will naturally lift the stock market.

items.title: 賴清德：2035年前穩定供電無虞 將助百萬家中小微企業導入AI
items.title_en: Lai Ching-te: Stable Power Supply Guaranteed Until 2035, Aiming to Help One Million SMEs Adopt AI
paras: 總統賴清德今(16)日接受財經網紅游庭皓的節目《游庭皓的財經皓角》專訪，賴清德除了談新十大AI建設、能源政策、經濟前景外，也強調台灣要全力發展AI產業，首要目標就是協助2040年之前，台灣至少有百萬家的中小型微企業可以導入AI順利升級轉型，若將AI要發展的電力需求計算，目前估計到2035年將穩定供電無虞。
賴清德表示，政府希望 AI 產業更強，但是一般勞工也能夠，分享相關的經濟成果，希望企業的獲利能夠提高，也希望能夠創造更多的中產階級工作。
賴清德重申，政府先前已提出AI新十大建設，如人才培育、打造算力與AI主權中心、穩定電力供應及台灣均衡發展，並聚焦矽光子、量子運算及機器人三項關鍵核心技術。
賴清德說，最終希望達到三個目標，一、協助2040年前培養至少有百萬家中小微企業導入AI，順利升級轉型；第二、打造創創業的生態系，在2040年前，能有1兆元產值的軟體平台；三、希望未來的台灣在食衣住行育樂、士農工商都可以運用人工智慧，讓台灣成為AI的生活圈，希望台灣能夠成為全球前5大AI應用及發展最好的國家。
針對AI可能吸走其他產業資源，讓其他產業較難發展。賴清德也表示，可能社會沒有注意到政府近10年來的努力，不管是在水、電、土地及人才等方面均衡發展，以水方面來講，已經打造西部供水廊道水源相連珍珠串計畫，強化供水調度，在電力方面，已將未來經濟發展、算力及AI產業的電力需求納入盤點，到2035年穩定供電都沒有問題。
賴清德強調，AI發展仰賴穩定能源供給，目前政府態度很明確，就是不要意識形態去排除任何一種能源，同時也不要因為短期利益，就不顧環境的永續，只要符合「安全無虞、核廢有解、社會共識」，就來推動核能，目前核電重啟程序，因立法院已經通過，所以台電也已經開始進行重啟評估，而台灣是一個民主的國家、法治的社會，必須尊重民意，那就讓程序去走。
賴清德強調，核電重啟就是交給專業來做決定，若有共識那就重啟，沒有的話那當然就要靜待先進的核能技術發展，讓電力供應AI發展不缺電。
paras_en: President Lai Ching-te was interviewed today (Oct. 16) on financial influencer You Ting-hao’s program “You Ting-hao’s Financial Corner.” In addition to discussing the new ten AI initiatives, energy policy and economic outlook, Lai stressed that Taiwan must fully develop its AI industry, with the primary goal of enabling at least one million small and micro enterprises to adopt AI and successfully upgrade before 2040. Based on calculations of AI’s power needs, a stable electricity supply is projected to be assured through 2035.

Lai said the government wants a stronger AI sector while ordinary workers also benefit, sharing the related economic gains. He hopes corporate profits will rise and more middle‑class jobs will be created.

Lai reiterated that the government has already put forward ten new AI projects, including talent cultivation, building a computing and AI sovereignty hub, ensuring stable power supply, and balanced regional development, with a focus on three key core technologies: silicon photonics, quantum computing and robotics.

He outlined three ultimate goals: first, to help at least one million small and micro enterprises adopt AI and upgrade before 2040; second, to create an entrepreneurial ecosystem that generates a NT$1 trillion software platform output by 2040; third, to embed AI across all aspects of life—food, clothing, housing, transportation, education, recreation, and all sectors of industry—so Taiwan becomes a top‑five global AI application and development nation.

Addressing concerns that AI might siphon resources from other industries, Lai noted that the public may overlook the government’s decade‑long efforts toward balanced development in water, electricity, land and talent. On water, the “Western Water Corridor Pearl Chain” project links sources to strengthen supply scheduling; on electricity, future economic growth, computing and AI power needs have been accounted for, and a stable supply through 2035 is assured.

Lai emphasized that AI development depends on stable energy. The government’s stance is clear: no ideology should exclude any energy source, and short‑term gains must not compromise environmental sustainability. As long as safety, nuclear waste solutions and social consensus are met, nuclear power will be promoted. The nuclear restart procedure has been approved by the legislature, and Taipower has begun restart assessments. Taiwan, as a democratic and rule‑of‑law society, must respect public opinion and let the process run its course.

Lai stressed that the nuclear restart decision is left to professionals; if consensus is reached, reactors will restart, otherwise Taiwan will await advances in advanced nuclear technology to ensure AI’s power needs are met without shortages.

在三大法人操作部分，外資今日賣超461.47億元、連續8個交易日站賣方；投信則反手操作，買117.54億元、連6買；自營商賣超334.13億元，三大法人合計賣超678.06億元。外資期貨部位，外資空單減少近3千口，外資淨空單仍位於高檔9.36萬口。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks today (the 16th) shook off yesterday’s frantic sell‑off, with the index surging more than 500 points mid‑session, but ending with a modest gain of 141.39 points to settle back at 47,000 points as heavyweight stocks faced heavy selling pressure. Trading volume shrank to NT$9.359 trillion and the weekly chart closed with four consecutive red candles. Foreign investors again acted as sellers, netting a sell of NT$46.147 billion for the eighth straight day, dumping 22,000 lots of TSMC (2330‑TW) – the largest single‑stock sell – and offloading 28,000 lots of the Yuanta Taiwan 50 ETF (0050‑TW).

Among the three major institutional groups, foreign investors sold NT$46.147 billion today, marking eight consecutive days of net selling; investment trusts went the opposite way, buying NT$11.754 billion for a six‑day buying streak; proprietary traders sold NT$33.413 billion. Combined, the three groups sold NT$67.806 billion. In the futures market, foreign investors reduced short positions by about 3,000 contracts, but their net short remained high at 93,600 contracts.

In the top‑10 net‑buy list for the day, foreign investors bought 43,700 lots of China Steel, the most bought stock, continuing a six‑day buying streak. They also bought 41,200 lots of Qunyi Taiwan Selected High‑Yield, 23,300 lots of AU Optronics, 22,000 lots each of Foxconn and China Airlines, 20,600 lots of Hualien Bank, 19,300 lots of KGI Fund, 15,300 lots of Walsin Technology, 15,000 lots of Taiwan Glass, and 14,300 lots of Mega Financial.

Among the top‑10 net‑sell stocks, foreign investors heavily trimmed heavyweight stocks, active and passive ETFs, and Formosa Plastics Group holdings. They sold 28,300 lots of the Yuanta Taiwan 50 ETF, the biggest seller, followed by 22,000 lots of the “king” stock TSMC – eight days of selling in a row – then 18,900 lots of Nanya, 14,000 lots of Formosa Plastics, 12,100 lots of Innolux, 10,100 lots of KGI Taiwan TOP50, 8,092 lots of the actively managed Uni‑Upgrade 50, 7,783 lots of Nanya Technology, 7,271 lots of the actively managed CTBC Taiwan Yield, and 7,215 lots of Cathay Philadelphia Semiconductor.

In the investment‑trust sector, the top‑10 net‑buy list was led by Qunyi Preferred Non‑Investment Bonds with 36,800 lots, followed by China Airlines (5,818 lots), Formosa Plastics Corp. (4,411 lots), Chunghwa Telecom (4,090 lots), Yuanta High Dividend (4,035 lots), Da‑Cheng Steel (3,615 lots), Evergreen Marine (3,077 lots), Golden Eagle Electronics (2,952 lots), and Yang Ming (2,657 lots).

Among investment trusts’ top‑10 net‑sell stocks, United Microelectronics Corp. topped the list with 18,300 lots sold, followed by Wistron NeWeb (4,201 lots), Mega Financial (3,826 lots), Hua Xin (3,011 lots), Fubon Financial (2,803 lots), Chih Shen (2,764 lots), Taishin Shin Kong Financial (2,602 lots), Siliconware (2,602 lots), Taiwan Cement (2,463 lots), and Strong-Mao (2,248 lots).

Analysts note that the Taiwan market remains below its 5‑day and 10‑day moving averages. The focus is on whether yesterday’s (the 15th) low around 46,795 points can hold, and on resistance near the recent high of about 47,521 points. If the market can hold the low, TSMC stabilises and semiconductors resume a rally, a recovery in volume could help challenge the upper resistance, with short‑term price likely to oscillate between the monthly and quarterly trend lines.

From a technical standpoint, the Taiwan market continues a weak consolidation, with the index still in a structure of weak electricity sector and strong gold sector. Short‑term price action is expected to swing between the monthly and quarterly lines. From a market‑sentiment perspective, foreign investors sold NT$46.1 billion of spot shares today, while net short positions in futures rose to 93,675 contracts, indicating a cautious and slightly pessimistic overall positioning.

items.title: 鴻海擬斥236億元取得三菱電機移動50%股權 共同經營汽車設備事業
items.title_en: Foxconn Plans to Spend NT$23.6 Billion to Acquire 50% of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, Jointly Operate Automotive Equipment Business
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(16)日公告，透過旗下投資管理子公司利億國際投資，將與三菱電機株式會社正式簽訂策略聯盟協議，共同經營汽車設備事業；利億預計將以1150億日圓(約新台幣236億元)取得三菱電機移動株式會社(Mitsubishi Electric Mobility)50%股權，預計於2027年10月1日完成股權移轉交易。
根據合作協議，三菱電機將旗下負責汽車設備事業的三菱電機移動株式會社50%股權移轉予利億，未來雙方將共同經營三菱電機移動。根據股權移轉協議，標的事業的企業價值（Enterprise Value）為3,200億日圓，股權價值（Equity Value）為2,300億日圓，本次交易價格則依股權價值計算，對應移轉50%股權。
本次股權移轉仍須符合相關契約條件，包括取得競爭法及其他適用法令所要求的主管機關核准與許可。待相關條件均獲滿足後，預計於2027年10月1日完成股權移轉交易。
鴻海表示，透過此次共同經營，雙方將結合三菱電機移動的技術與研發實力，尤其是電子動力系統（electric powertrain）、軟體及車輛控制等領域的優勢，以及鴻海在執行速度、規模化發展與市場落地方面的能力，共同打造源自日本的高品質電動車平台（基礎架構），推動次世代移動解決方案的普及與發展。
此次策略聯盟將結合日本製造業長期累積的先進技術與品質優勢，為次世代移動領域創造新的價值，進一步強化日本國內產業基礎，並支持汽車產業永續成長。展望中長期，雙方將致力於將日本的技術與品質推向全球市場，進一步提升「Made in/by Japan」的價值，並向全球展現日本製造業的發展潛力。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today, October 16, that through its investment‑management subsidiary Li‑Yi International Investment it will sign a strategic alliance agreement with Mitsubishi Electric Corp. to jointly operate the automotive equipment business. Li‑Yi intends to purchase a 50% stake in Mitsubishi Electric Mobility for ¥1.15 trillion (about NT$23.6 billion), with the share‑transfer expected to be completed on October 1, 2027.

Under the cooperation agreement, Mitsubishi Electric will transfer its 50% ownership of Mitsubishi Electric Mobility, the unit responsible for automotive equipment, to Li‑Yi. The two parties will thereafter co‑manage Mitsubishi Electric Mobility. The enterprise value of the target business is ¥320 billion, the equity value ¥230 billion, and the transaction price is based on the equity value for the 50% share being transferred.

The share transfer remains subject to meeting contractual conditions, including obtaining approvals and permits required by competition law and other applicable regulations. Once all conditions are satisfied, the transfer is slated to close on October 1, 2027.

Foxconn said that through this joint operation the parties will combine Mitsubishi Electric Mobility’s technology and R&D strengths—particularly in electric powertrains, software and vehicle control—with Foxconn’s speed of execution, scale‑up capability and market rollout expertise to build a high‑quality electric‑vehicle platform rooted in Japan and promote the adoption and development of next‑generation mobility solutions.

The strategic alliance will fuse Japan’s long‑standing advanced manufacturing technology and quality advantage to create new value in next‑generation mobility, further strengthening the domestic industrial base and supporting sustainable growth of the automotive sector. Over the medium to long term, both sides aim to bring Japanese technology and quality to global markets, enhancing the value of “Made in/by Japan” and showcasing the development potential of Japanese manufacturing worldwide.

items.title: 經濟部擬赴德州設立AI產業園區 童子賢：可借鏡廣達Q-Bus模式
items.title_en: MOEA Plans to Set Up AI Industry Park in Texas, Tong Tzu-Hsien: Can Model After Quanta’s Q‑Bus Approach
paras: 經濟部將赴美國德州設立AI產業園區，和碩(4938-TW)董事長童子賢今(16)日出席東元70週年論壇，被問及此事，指出可借鏡廣達(2382-TW)過去到上海松江打造的「Q-Bus」模式「向巴士一般，整個打包運過去」，將有助中小企業於當地快速落地，並形成產業鏈。
經濟部計畫於美國德州設立AI產業園區，投資成本最高達40億美元，並由經濟部與電電公會共同推動。
對此，童子賢表示，大型企業如台積電(2330-TW)赴亞利桑那州設廠，從基礎設施、員工居住等都可以「自己包」，不過像是無塵衣清洗、特用材料及小型零件加工品等作業再回到台灣執行，恐怕影響效率，因此仍需完整的產業聚落支持。
童子賢進一步指出，政府要到德州設立產業園區，可比照廣達於上海松江的Q-Bus模式，讓缺乏國際經驗的供應商可快速落地。他並指出，倘若從營建施工、員工食宿、醫療、子女教育，到向當地政府申請水電執照以及廢水廢棄物處理等程序都要自行摸索，直言「這樣效率很低」。
童子賢也提到，台灣在科學園區管理已累積成熟及豐富經驗，並以和碩在越南海防的經驗為例，當地有比利時開發商統包填海造陸、廢水處理、發電及海水淡化，企業可申請服務並支付費用，進駐後便可運作，有助提高營運效率。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs will go to Texas, USA to establish an AI industry park, and Hon Hai Precision Industry (4938‑TW) chairman Tong Tzu‑Hsien attended the TECO 70th anniversary forum today (the 16th). When asked about the plan, he said that they can learn from Quanta Computer’s (2382‑TW) past “Q‑Bus” model built in Songjiang, Shanghai – essentially “packaged like a bus and shipped over” – which will help small and medium‑sized enterprises settle quickly on site and form a supply chain.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs plans to set up an AI industry park in Texas, with a maximum investment of up to US$4 billion, and the project will be promoted jointly by the ministry and the Electrical and Electronics Manufacturers’ Association.

Tong said that large firms such as TSMC (2330‑TW) building factories in Arizona can “bundle” everything from basic infrastructure to employee housing themselves. However, operations such as clean‑room garment cleaning, special‑material processing, and small‑component machining that would have to be done back in Taiwan could hurt efficiency, so a complete industrial ecosystem is still needed.

He added that the government should follow Quanta’s Q‑Bus model in Songjiang, allowing suppliers with little international experience to set up quickly in Texas. He warned that if companies have to figure out everything on their own—from construction, employee lodging, medical care, children’s education, to applying for local water‑electricity permits and waste‑water treatment—the efficiency would be very low.

Tong also noted that Taiwan has accumulated mature and rich experience in managing science parks, citing Hon Hai’s experience in Haiphong, Vietnam. There, a Belgian developer handled land‑reclamation, wastewater treatment, power generation and seawater desalination under a turnkey contract; companies can simply apply for the services and pay fees, allowing them to operate immediately after moving in, which improves operational efficiency.

items.title: 華新焦佑倫談能源 風電與核電都是絕對必要選項
paras: 華新(1605-TW)董事長焦佑倫今(16)日出席東元70週年論壇，被問及能源議題，指出電力是台灣的命脈，且面對國際對淨零碳排與綠電比例要求，台灣目前綠電比重仍低，因此認為風電及核電都是絕對必要的選項。
焦佑倫指出，台灣土地資源有限，而海域面積比國土面積還大，雖然離岸風電成本較高，但不應僅考量土地資源，海域與天然資源也應一併納入考慮，而台灣的「風」具相對優勢，認為台灣的風場是全世界最好的風場，因此不能沒有風電。
焦佑倫進一步表示，目前風電的成本每度約4元，短期內看似偏高，但10年後未必昂貴。同時，他也提到，核電必然是全球發電的主力，更對於台灣長期電價具正面意義，認為台灣應核綠共存。
此外，焦佑倫也談到國產化議題，指出風電國產化並非只有保護本土產業，而是基於供應鏈韌性與安全考量，雖短期內會有成本較高的問題，但隨著技術成熟、規模化，加上台灣產業供應鏈相對完整，成本將逐步下降，且產業競爭力將同步提升。

items.title: 摩根士丹利發出最新警告：記憶體股低本益比恐為周期頂峰「估值陷阱」
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Issues New Warning: Low P/E Ratios in Memory Stocks May Signal a Cycle‑Peak Valuation Trap
paras: 在人工智慧(AI)強勁需求的推升下，全球記憶體晶片產業正經歷前所未有的超級周期。然而，摩根士丹利分析師 Shawn Kim 在近期研報《記憶體：周期與超級周期》(Memory – Cycles vs. Super Cycles)中發出警告，指出儘管 AI 驅動的榮景屬實，但「最容易賺的錢已經過去」。
報告特別提醒投資人，記憶體股票往往恰恰在周期頂峰時看起來最便宜，目前的低本益比恐怕隱含著危險的估值陷阱。

低本益比隱含風險

自 2025 年 9 月本輪周期啟動以來，亞洲記憶體股價已暴漲約 9 倍，市場對亞洲記憶體企業的每股盈餘(EPS)平均上修幅度高達 432%。目前三星電子與 SK 海力士預估本益比僅約 3.5 至 3.7 倍，美光(MU-US)約 6.1 倍，遠低於輝達(NVDA-US)的 17.8 倍與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)的 23 倍。
對此，Kim 測算，若要支撐當前股價繼續大幅上漲，DRAM 合約價需在現有水準上實現月率上漲約 70% 的極高門檻，這在現實中極難達成。相比之下，研調機構 TrendForce 預估 2026 年第四季傳統 DRAM 合約季增(QoQ)約 10% 至 15%。
摩根士丹利回顧 2008 年、2012 年與 2018 年的歷史數據警告，記憶體股價拐點通常會比企業盈餘頂峰提前 4 至 8 個月出現，市場習慣將高盈餘過度外推，導致本益比最低時反而最危險。

超級周期基本面強勁

儘管對股價前景趨於謹慎，報告並未否認當前強勁的基本面。三星電子在 2026 年第三季創下高達 800 億美元的營業利潤，刷新科技業歷史紀錄；高頻寬記憶體(HBM)市場規模預計於 2028 年翻三倍至 1,000 億美元。台灣廠商南亞科(2408-TW)9 月營收年率大增 576.62%。
然而，高額利潤促使各大晶圓廠大幅增加資本支出，預計 2026 年 DRAM 資本支出將年增 82% 至 980 億美元，2027 年更將進一步增至 1,500 億至 1,600 億美元。隨著中國記憶體廠商長鑫存儲(CXMT)與長江存儲(YMTC)快速擴產，以及新建產能預計於 2027 年下半年逐步釋放，產業供需失衡的局面恐被反轉。

摩根士丹利重塑投資優先順序

報告進一步分析，隨著 AI 資料中心規模擴大，硬體系統的價值分配正在發生變化。以輝達 NVL72 系統為例，當單機架擴展至 8 機架互聯時，記憶體佔系統價值的比重由 29% 降至 19%，而網路設備的比重則由 10% 提升至 20%。
基於此結構性轉移，Kim 建議將 AI 產業鏈的投資偏好重新排序為：AI 算力第一、網路設備第二、記憶體晶片第三，並對面臨成本高企與產能過剩風險的下游硬體持最保守態度。近期如 SK 海力士與三星股價單日重挫逾 8% 至 9%、日本鎧俠(Kioxia)較高點回檔約 58.6%，均顯示市場已開始重新評估周期風險。
paras_en: Driven by strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI), the global memory‑chip industry is undergoing an unprecedented super‑cycle. However, Morgan Stanley analyst Shawn Kim warned in a recent research note, “Memory: Cycles vs. Super Cycles,” that although the AI‑driven boom is real, “the easiest money has already been made.”
The report specifically cautions investors that memory stocks often appear cheapest precisely at the peak of a cycle, and today’s low price‑to‑earnings ratios may hide a dangerous valuation trap.

Low P/E risk Since the current cycle began in September 2025, Asian memory stocks have surged roughly nine‑fold, with the market revising earnings per share (EPS) forecasts for Asian memory firms upward by an average of 432%. Samsung and SK Hynix now project P/E ratios of only about 3.5‑3.7 times, while Micron (MU‑US) is around 6.1 times—far below Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) 17.8 times and TSMC’s (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) 23 times.

Kim estimates that to sustain the present steep price gains, DRAM contract prices would need to rise about 70% month‑over‑month from current levels—a threshold that is extremely hard to achieve in reality. By contrast, research firm TrendForce forecasts traditional DRAM contract quarterly growth of roughly 10%‑15% in Q4 2026.

Morgan Stanley reviewed historical data from 2008, 2012 and 2018 and warned that memory‑stock inflection points typically occur 4‑8 months before earnings peaks. The market’s habit of over‑projecting high earnings makes the lowest P/E ratios the most hazardous.

Super‑cycle fundamentals remain strong Despite a more cautious outlook for stock prices, the report does not deny the strong fundamentals. Samsung posted a record‑high operating profit of $80 billion in Q3 2026, a tech‑industry record; the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) market is expected to triple to $100 billion by 2028. Taiwan’s Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) saw September revenue jump 576.62% year‑over‑year.

However, the hefty profits are prompting wafer fabs to sharply increase capital spending, with DRAM capex projected to rise 82% to $98 billion in 2026 and further to $150‑$160 billion in 2027. Rapid expansion by China’s CXMT and YMTC, together with new capacity slated for gradual release in the second half of 2027, could reverse the current supply‑demand imbalance.

Morgan Stanley reshapes investment priorities The note further analyzes that as AI data‑center scale expands, the value allocation within hardware systems is shifting. Using Nvidia’s NVL72 system as an example, when a single rack scales to an eight‑rack interconnect, memory’s share of system value falls from 29% to 19%, while networking equipment’s share rises from 10% to 20%.

Based on this structural shift, Kim recommends re‑ranking AI‑industry‑chain investment preferences to: AI compute first, networking equipment second, memory chips third, and taking the most conservative stance toward downstream hardware facing high costs and overcapacity risks. Recent single‑day drops of over 8%‑9% in SK Hynix and Samsung shares, and Kioxia’s roughly 58.6% pullback from its highs, both signal the market is beginning to reassess cycle risks.

items.title: 《巴隆》解析輝達為何相對抗跌！AI債務疑慮引爆半導體股賣壓
items.title_en: Baron Analysis: Why Nvidia Is Relatively Resilient Amid AI Debt Concerns Sparking Semiconductor Stock Selling Pressure
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 週五（16日）股價雖然仍承受賣壓，但相較之下展現出一定韌性；與此同時，其他半導體類股持續遭到拋售，跌勢已演變成該產業十多年來最嚴重的賣壓之一。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達週四（15日）下跌 1.8% 後，週五盤前股價在平盤下方徘徊，此前一度上漲近 1%。自 10 月 6 日以來，輝達股價已下跌 9%。
追蹤半導體類股的安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 自 10 月 6 日以來已連續 8 個交易日下跌，創 2015 年 9 月以來最長連跌紀錄。週五開盤前，安碩半導體ETF下跌 0.4%，可能將連跌紀錄延長至 9 個交易日。盤中，安碩半導體ETF則下跌1.41%。
近幾日，隨著市場對 AI 擴建所需債務不斷增加的疑慮升高，進一步加劇半導體類股的跌勢，其中雲端運算業者 CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 尤其受到關注。
不過，輝達執行長黃仁勳週四表示，輝達不需要為 CoreWeave 提供財務擔保，緩解投資人疑慮，帶動輝達股價自當日低點反彈。輝達同時是 CoreWeave 的供應商、客戶與投資人。
週五盤前，輝達的反彈似乎有加速跡象，而截稿前，輝達週五盤中下跌0.50%。相較之下，同業超微半導體(AMD-US) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 盤前均下跌逾 1%。盤中，超微半導體下跌3.27%，英特爾則下跌2.06%。
針對輝達股價為何相對抗跌，《巴隆》指出其中一個原因可能是，經歷一段時間的持續下跌後，輝達股價對投資人而言已變得更具吸引力。
輝達是全球市值最高的上市公司，也是近年 AI 投資熱潮中最受青睞的股票之一，而技術指標也提供了相關線索。
在近期跌勢中，輝達股價於 10 月 6 日跌破 50 日與 200 日簡單移動平均線（SMA），此後大多時間都在這兩個傳統技術支撐水準下方徘徊。
週四交易期間，輝達股價一度跌至 213 美元，當時 50 日均線約為 220 美元，200 日均線則約為 224 美元。
黃仁勳發表談話後，股價反彈，與 50 日均線的差距明顯縮小，來到 217.23 美元，僅略低於 217.37 美元的 50 日均線。若反彈走勢延續至週五，技術指標將開始呈現更為看漲的訊號。
從基本面來看，黃仁勳的安撫性談話，很可能也讓原本擔心輝達在整體 AI 產業債務風險中所處位置的投資人稍感安心。
這或許足以支撐輝達自身股價，但黃仁勳能否進一步提振市場信心、帶動整個半導體產業止跌，並阻止賣壓持續擴大，仍有待觀察。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) saw its share price still under selling pressure on Friday (the 16th), but it showed a degree of resilience; at the same time, other semiconductor stocks continued to be sold off, with the decline becoming one of the worst in the sector in more than a decade.

According to Barron's, Nvidia fell 1.8% on Thursday (the 15th) and traded below the flat line in pre‑market trading on Friday after briefly rallying nearly 1%. Since October 6, Nvidia’s stock has dropped 9%.

The SOXX semiconductor ETF, which tracks semiconductor stocks, has fallen for eight consecutive trading days since October 6, setting the longest losing streak since September 2015. Ahead of Friday’s open, the ETF was down 0.4%, potentially extending the streak to nine days, and it fell 1.41% during the session.

In recent days, growing market worries about the mounting debt needed to expand AI capacity have further intensified the sell‑off in semiconductor stocks, with cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) drawing particular attention.

However, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said on Thursday that Nvidia does not need to provide financial guarantees for CoreWeave, easing investor concerns and prompting Nvidia’s shares to rebound from the day’s low. Nvidia is also a supplier, customer and investor in CoreWeave.

In pre‑market trading on Friday, Nvidia’s rebound appeared to accelerate, but by the time of publication the stock was down 0.50% during Friday’s session. By contrast, peers AMD (AMD-US) and Intel (INTC-US) were both down more than 1% in pre‑market trading, with AMD falling 3.27% and Intel 2.06% during the day.
Barron noted that one reason Nvidia’s stock is holding up better is that, after a prolonged decline, its price has become more attractive to investors.
Nvidia is the world’s largest‑valued public company and one of the most favored stocks in the recent AI investment boom, and technical indicators also provide clues.
During the recent decline, Nvidia’s price fell below its 50‑day and 200‑day simple moving averages on October 6 and has spent most of the time since then below these traditional support levels.
During Thursday’s trading, Nvidia’s price briefly dropped to $213, while the 50‑day moving average was around $220 and the 200‑day average about $224.

After Huang’s remarks, the stock rebounded, narrowing the gap to the 50‑day average to $217.23, just below the $217.37 50‑day line. If the rebound continues into Friday, the technical indicators could turn more bullish.
From a fundamentals perspective, Huang’s reassuring comments likely eased investors’ worries about Nvidia’s exposure to overall AI‑industry debt risk.

Whether this support is enough to sustain Nvidia’s own share price, and whether Huang can further boost market confidence, halt the broader semiconductor decline and curb the expanding sell pressure, remains to be seen.

items.title: iPhone Duo預購秒罄 首批現貨溢價2,9000元起
items.title_en: iPhone Duo pre‑orders sold out in seconds, first‑batch stock premium starts at 29,000 yuan
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊機16日（周五）晚開啟預購，起售價為人民幣（下同）15,999元，10月23日正式發售。
在蘋果預購開啟前，iPhone Duo就展現出超高市場熱度，京東平台的產品預約量已突破200萬，遠超同期常規旗艦機型預約。
據《藍鯨新聞》報導，有網友今晚在多平台搶購，進入購買頁面後顯示無法支付，頁面宕機數秒後，首批現貨便已售罄，約15分鐘後，購得的機子發貨日期已排到12月5日。
供需缺口帶動iPhone Duo在市場上出現明顯溢價，在得物上，iPhone Duo成交訂單超過700單，原本15,999元的256G版本，成交價高達2.19萬元。
另在其餘二手平台上，iPhone Duo也有不同程度溢價，整體溢價在6,000元（新台幣29,079元）至10,000元不等。
有黃牛表示，若果粉想在10月23日拿到iPhone Duo首批現貨，至少需加價6,000元。
不過，也有商家態度更為謹慎，稱該機行情尚未明朗，報價每日浮動，但可以確定的是，iPhone Duo會成為有史以來溢價最高的機型。
蘋果中國官網顯示，iPhone Duo提供四個容量版本，256GB售15,999元、512GB售17,999元、1TB售21,499元、2TB售26,499元。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) launched pre‑orders for its first foldable phone on the evening of the 16th (Friday) at a starting price of RMB 15,999, with official sales beginning on October 23.
Before pre‑orders opened, the iPhone Duo already showed huge market hype, with reservation orders on JD.com exceeding 2 million, far surpassing those for regular flagship models at the same time.

According to Blue Whale News, some netizens tried to buy on multiple platforms tonight; after entering the purchase page they saw a payment error, the page crashed for a few seconds and the first batch of stock sold out. About 15 minutes later, the delivery date for the phones they managed to purchase was pushed to December 5.

The supply‑demand gap has created a clear premium for the iPhone Duo in the market. On the DeWu platform, more than 700 orders were placed, and the 256 GB version that normally costs RMB 15,999 was sold for as much as RMB 21,900.
On other resale platforms, the iPhone Duo also carries varying premiums, overall ranging from RMB 6,000 (NT$29,079) to RMB 10,000.
Resellers say that if fans want to get the first‑batch stock on October 23, they will need to pay at least an extra RMB 6,000.

However, some merchants are more cautious, saying the market situation is still unclear and prices fluctuate daily, but it is certain that the iPhone Duo will become the most premium‑priced device in history.
Apple’s China website shows four storage options for the iPhone Duo: 256 GB at RMB 15,999; 512 GB at RMB 17,999; 1 TB at RMB 21,499; and 2 TB at RMB 26,499.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI疑慮壓抑晶片股、特斯拉撐盤 主要指數漲跌互現
paras: 美股周五(16日)開盤漲跌互現，本周朝收黑邁進。市場對人工智慧(AI)投資熱潮的疑慮持續壓抑半導體股，科技與AI相關類股本周走弱，讓投資人保持謹慎；特斯拉(TSLA-US)上漲則為大盤提供部分支撐。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近250點或近0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近150點或0.6%，標普 500 指數跌0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近1.7%，台積電ADR跌近1.8%。
美股科技股歷經一周重挫後，股指期貨周五小幅走高，但投資人仍保持謹慎。市場同時消化資金撤出人工智慧(AI)交易、美債強勢反彈，以及通膨高於預期等變化，標普500指數期貨上漲0.1%，晶片股盤前持續承壓。
個股方面，特斯拉(TSLA-US)發表延宕多時的新款Roadster跑車後，盤前上漲3.5%；CoreWeave(CRWV-US)則因信用風險疑慮未消，再跌5%。歐洲Stoxx 600指數本周相對標普500的表現，可望創8月以來最大領先幅度。
美債殖利率周五恢復上行，10年期殖利率上升4個基點，但全周仍可望創2月以來最大降幅。美元料連續第二周走弱，布蘭特原油則在每桶106美元附近震盪。
隨著市場愈來愈擔心AI基礎建設成本，科技股本周遭遇沉重賣壓，那斯達克100指數自周一以來下跌3%，美債則重新獲得避險資金青睞。另一方面，高能源價格正向全球經濟傳導，使各國央行持續面臨收緊政策的壓力。
隆奧資產管理宏觀研究主管Florian Ielpo表示，經濟仍在擴張，但家庭與負債較高的企業正承受壓力，因此看好政府公債，股票投資則須更審慎篩選。
聯準會(Fed)主席華許在國際貨幣基金(IMF)年會對談中，未對近期政策方向表態。交易員隨後將10月升息押注降至約15%，回吐本周通膨數據高於預期後的部分升幅。
桑坦德資產管理的Francisco Simón認為，華許的語氣展現政策紀律，而非急於行動，重點在於持續關注通膨，同時避免反應過度。
Simón指出，企業財報將是下周市場的主要催化因素。投資人日益重視管理層展望，需要確認企業獲利前景仍足以支撐估值。Ielpo則表示，AI投資能否在目前融資成本下創造可觀報酬，是關鍵問題；油價對通膨與家庭購買力的影響也不容忽視。
亞洲方面，知情人士透露，中國正鼓勵企業與國有基金買進股票，並引導部分投資人減少賣出，以穩定股市。相關基準指數今年下跌約10%，周四收在2025年8月以來最低，北京當局力圖避免賣壓演變成惡性循環。
《彭博》宏觀策略師Skylar Montgomery Koning指出，即使本周重要經濟數據高於預期，美債殖利率仍下滑，顯示市場對AI熱潮明顯降溫的擔憂，可能蓋過供給衝擊引發的通膨風險，使債券重新發揮對沖股票風險的作用。

items.title: 車子能飛，股價也能飛嗎？特斯拉Roadster帶動股價反彈，與SpaceX合併傳聞再起
items.title_en: Can Cars Fly, and Can Stock Prices Soar? Tesla Roadster Sparks Share Rally Amid New SpaceX Merger Rumors
paras: 2026年10月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克（Elon Musk）再次以新技術吸引市場目光。公司15日晚間展示新一代Roadster電動跑車，透過與SpaceX合作開發的推進技術，讓車輛短暫騰空、在空中翻轉，甚至完成倒掛行駛等特殊動作，帶動特斯拉16日美股盤前一度上漲逾5%。
這款新一代Roadster早在2017年便已公布，但量產時程多次延後。此次展示的車輛結合高壓空氣推進器與吸附系統，能夠短暫離地及完成特殊動作，但與一般可持續飛行的航空器仍有明顯差異。特斯拉目前規劃2028年開始生產，至於展示中的特殊功能能否完整導入量產車款，以及相關售價與市場需求，仍有待後續確認。
對特斯拉而言，Roadster更像是展示工程技術與品牌創新能力的產品，而非短期營收成長的主要來源。
由於高性能跑車市場規模相對有限，即使未來順利量產，對公司整體汽車業務的貢獻可能仍相當有限。市場對特斯拉的長期估值，主要仍聚焦自動駕駛、Optimus人形機器人，以及其他新業務的商業化進展。因此，Roadster能否帶動股價持續上漲，關鍵恐怕不只在於車輛性能，而是投資人是否認為這些技術最終能轉化為實際營收與獲利。
不過，Roadster採用SpaceX相關推進技術，讓外界重新討論兩家公司未來深化合作，甚至合併的可能性。巴克萊銀行Barclays分析師Dan Levy先前指出，兩家公司可能在數週內宣布合併計畫，時間點甚至可能早於特斯拉預定12月6日前舉行的年度股東大會。
若交易成真，可能成為史上規模最大的企業合併案，並將馬斯克旗下的自動駕駛、機器人、AI模型及半導體製造業務整合至同一企業體系。

paras_en: On October 16, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center), Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk once again captured market attention with new technology. On the evening of the 15th, the company showcased a next‑generation Roadster electric sports car that, using propulsion technology developed with SpaceX, briefly lifted off the ground, performed aerial flips and even drove upside‑down, prompting Tesla shares to rise more than 5% in pre‑market trading on the 16th.

The new Roadster was first announced back in 2017, but its production timeline has been delayed repeatedly. The displayed vehicle combines a high‑pressure air thruster with an adhesion system, allowing it to momentarily leave the ground and execute special maneuvers, though it remains fundamentally different from aircraft capable of sustained flight. Tesla plans to start production in 2028, and it remains to be seen whether the showcased features will make it into production models, what the pricing will be, and how strong market demand will be.
For Tesla, the Roadster serves more as a showcase of engineering prowess and brand innovation rather than a short‑term revenue driver.

Because the high‑performance sports‑car market is relatively small, even if the Roadster reaches production, its contribution to Tesla’s overall automotive business is likely to stay modest. Long‑term valuation of Tesla continues to focus on autonomous driving, the Optimus humanoid robot, and the commercialization of other new businesses. Thus, whether the Roadster can sustain a stock‑price boost depends less on the car’s performance and more on whether investors believe these technologies will eventually translate into real revenue and profit.

However, the Roadster’s use of SpaceX‑related propulsion technology has revived speculation about deeper cooperation between the two companies, even a possible merger. Barclays analyst Dan Levy previously suggested that the two firms could announce a merger plan within weeks, potentially before Tesla’s scheduled annual shareholders’ meeting on December 6.

If the deal materializes, it could become the largest corporate merger in history, consolidating Musk’s autonomous‑driving, robotics, AI model, and semiconductor manufacturing businesses into a single corporate entity.

items.title: Photoshop訂閱還留得住？AI競爭讓Adobe遭分析師空前看淡
items.title_en: Can Photoshop Subscriptions Still Hold Up? AI Competition Leaves Adobe Facing Unprecedented Analyst Pessimism
paras: Adobe(ADBE-US)面臨AI競爭的疑慮持續升高，分析師對這家創意軟體大廠的看法降至歷來最悲觀。本周再有兩家券商調降評等，擔憂AI工具侵蝕Photoshop等產品需求，削弱長期成長動能。
富國證券周一將Adobe評等由「加碼」連降兩級至「減碼」，12個月目標價從270美元下修至225美元，使相當於「賣出」的評等增至七個，創歷史新高；2025年中時，這類評等仍為零。
分析師Michael Turrin表示，Adobe的成長前景正出現更明顯裂痕。他形容上月公布的第三季業績表現平淡，加上管理層近期表示將延後核心創意產品漲價，全年目標恐難達成。
匯豐分析師Stephen Bersey周二也將評等由「買進」降至「持有」，目標價從310美元降至267美元，直言Adobe確實可能受到AI顛覆。
今年以來，分析師已至少15次調降Adobe評等，使其反映買進、持有與賣出建議分布的綜合評分，降至滿分5分中的3.16分，創歷史新低，遠低於標普500軟體指數成分股平均的4.65分。
AI顛覆風險是今年軟體股的重要議題。年初，OpenAI與Anthropic等AI原生企業接連推出產品，引發軟體股廣泛賣壓。隨著投資人認為部分軟體仍難以取代，產業情緒大致回穩，Adobe卻是明顯例外。
Adobe今年股價已跌近30%，相較之下，追蹤軟體產業的iShares擴展科技軟體類股ETF(IGV-US)上漲3.7%。Adobe恐連續第三年跌逾20%，反映市場將其視為AI衝擊傳統軟體業的代表。
投資人擔心，使用者可能取消Photoshop訂閱，改以AI工具輸入提示詞生成影像。儘管Adobe也推出自家AI功能，競爭仍可能壓縮其定價能力與利潤率。
這也是匯豐降評的核心考量。Bersey指出，透過提示詞讓AI撰寫程式的「氛圍編碼」(Vibe Coding)，正催生功能仿照Adobe的新工具。他援引媒體報導稱，ArtCraft免費提供的軟體，涵蓋仿照Photoshop、Illustrator、Premiere、Lightroom、Acrobat、After Effects與InDesign的版本。
Bersey認為，這類競爭即使對使用者存在風險，仍可能因相關消息引發市場疑慮，持續對Adobe構成壓力。
paras_en: Adobe (ADBE-US) is facing rising concerns over AI competition, and analysts’ outlook for the creative‑software giant has dropped to its most pessimistic ever. This week two more brokerages cut their ratings, fearing AI tools will erode demand for Photoshop and other products and weaken long‑term growth momentum.

Wells Fargo Securities on Monday downgraded Adobe from an "overweight" to a "underweight" rating, cutting its 12‑month target price from $270 to $225, effectively raising the number of "sell" ratings to seven – a record high; by mid‑2025 the rating is expected to be zero.

Analyst Michael Turrin said Adobe’s growth outlook is showing a clearer crack. He described last month’s third‑quarter results as flat and noted that management’s recent decision to postpone price hikes on core creative products makes the full‑year target hard to achieve.
HSBC analyst Stephen Bersey on Tuesday also lowered his rating from "buy" to "hold" and cut the target price from $310 to $267, stating plainly that Adobe could indeed be disrupted by AI.

Since the start of the year analysts have cut Adobe’s rating at least 15 times, dragging its composite score – which reflects buy, hold and sell recommendations – down to 3.16 out of 5, a historic low and well below the S&P 500 software index average of 4.65.

AI disruption risk is a major theme for software stocks this year. Early in the year, AI‑native firms such as OpenAI and Anthropic rolled out products that sparked broad selling pressure in software equities. While investors have begun to see that some software remains hard to replace and sentiment has largely steadied, Adobe remains a clear outlier.

Adobe’s stock has fallen nearly 30% so far this year, whereas the iShares Expanded Tech‑Software ETF (IGV-US), which tracks the software sector, is up 3.7%. Adobe may see a third consecutive year of declines exceeding 20%, reflecting the market’s view of it as a poster child for AI’s impact on traditional software.

Investors worry users might cancel Photoshop subscriptions and switch to AI tools that generate images from text prompts. Even though Adobe has launched its own AI features, competition could still compress its pricing power and profit margins.

That concern is at the heart of HSBC’s downgrade. Bersey noted that AI‑generated "Vibe Coding" – using prompts to write code – is spawning new tools that mimic Adobe’s functionality. He cited media reports that the free ArtCraft software suite offers versions replicating Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, Lightroom, Acrobat, After Effects and InDesign.
Bersey believes that even if this competition poses a risk to users, related news can stir market unease and continue to pressure Adobe.

items.title: iPad Mini 8要來了？新款保護套曝光  傳將搭載OLED螢幕、強化防水
items.title_en: iPad Mini 8 Coming? New Case Leaked, Rumored to Feature OLED Screen and Enhanced Water Resistance
paras: 蘋果法國法規網站近日出現一款尚未正式發布的 iPad mini Smart Folio 保護套，型號為 A3632，與現有及過往 iPad mini 保護套的型號均不相同，引發外界對新一代 iPad mini 即將推出的猜測。
根據《MacRumors》報導，這款保護套似乎是蘋果近期新增至網站的產品，並與公司 9 月新增的 iPhone 18 Pro 配件一同列出。
不過，相關頁面並未透露新款 iPad mini 的規格，也未說明這款保護套的發布時間。
新款 Smart Folio 的出現，可能意味著下一代 iPad mini 的機身設計有所調整，因為這代表現有保護套未必能與新機相容。
市場傳聞指出，蘋果可能於 10 月 27 日或 28 日推出 iPad mini 8，新機預計配備 OLED 螢幕，並採用防水能力更佳的設計，同時亮相的產品還可能包括搭載 OLED 螢幕的 MacBook Pro。
報導認為，A3632 型號的 Smart Folio 可能就是為 OLED 版 iPad mini 所設計。
paras_en: Apple's French regulatory website recently displayed an as‑yet‑unreleased iPad mini Smart Folio case, model A3632, which differs from existing and past iPad mini case model numbers, sparking speculation that a new generation iPad mini is about to be launched.
According to MacRumors, the case appears to be a product Apple recently added to the site, listed together with the iPhone 18 Pro accessories that were added in September.
However, the page does not disclose the specifications of the new iPad mini, nor does it state when the case will be released.
The appearance of a new Smart Folio could indicate that the next‑generation iPad mini’s chassis design has changed, because the existing cases may not be compatible with the new device.

Market rumors suggest Apple may unveil the iPad mini 8 on October 27 or 28, with the new model expected to sport an OLED display and improved water‑resistance, and the same event could also introduce a MacBook Pro equipped with an OLED screen.
The report says the A3632‑named Smart Folio is likely designed for an OLED version of the iPad mini.

items.title: AI代理擴大資料存取風險，Proofpoint擬斥63億美元收購資安廠Varonis
items.title_en: Proofpoint Plans $6.3 Billion Cash Deal to Acquire Data Security Firm Varonis Amid Growing AI Agent Data Access Risks
paras: 2026年10月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 資安業者Proofpoint於10月15日宣布，將以約63億美元現金收購資料安全公司Varonis Systems(VRNS-US)，每股收購價49.75美元。這筆交易瞄準企業導入AI代理後的資料保護需求，雙方計畫整合通訊防護、敏感資料辨識與存取權限管理，建立涵蓋人員、資料及AI的資安平台。
兩家公司的防護重點各有側重。Proofpoint主要協助企業保護電子郵件、雲端及協作工具，降低釣魚攻擊與資料外洩風險；Varonis則深入企業資料環境，辨識敏感資訊存放在哪裡、哪些人或AI工具可以存取，以及資料實際如何被使用，涵蓋雲端、軟體即服務、資料庫與企業自建系統。
隨著AI代理從回答問題進一步代替員工操作系統，企業需要管理的已不只是使用者帳號，也包括代理能接觸哪些資料、執行哪些動作。Proofpoint執行長Sumit Dhawan表示，AI代理正跨系統存取敏感資訊並採取行動，因此除了保護資料與控管權限，也必須掌握實際使用情況。雙方預計透過產品整合，將攻擊入口防護與內部資料管理串接起來；合併後將服務逾1.6萬家企業。
交易已獲Varonis董事會一致通過，預計2027年上半年完成，仍須取得股東與監管機關批准。完成前兩家公司維持獨立營運，交割後Varonis將自那斯達克下市。Proofpoint的投資方Thoma Bravo將提供股權資金，並已取得債務融資承諾；安大略省教師退休基金也同意配合交易投資Proofpoint。

paras_en: On October 15, Proofpoint, a cybersecurity company, announced it will acquire data‑security firm Varonis Systems (VRNS‑US) for roughly $6.3 billion in cash at $49.75 per share. The deal targets the heightened data‑protection needs of enterprises deploying AI agents, with both parties planning to combine communication protection, sensitive‑data identification and access‑rights management into a security platform that covers people, data and AI.

The two firms focus on different protection areas. Proofpoint mainly helps enterprises safeguard email, cloud and collaboration tools, reducing phishing attacks and data‑leakage risk, while Varonis digs deep into corporate data environments to pinpoint where sensitive information resides, who—or which AI tools—can access it, and how the data is actually used, covering cloud, SaaS, databases and on‑premise systems.

As AI agents evolve from answering questions to performing employee tasks, companies must manage not only user accounts but also which data agents can reach and what actions they can take. Proofpoint CEO Sumit Dhawan said AI agents are crossing system boundaries to access sensitive information and act on it, so beyond protecting data and controlling permissions, firms must monitor actual usage. The companies expect product integration to link attack‑surface protection with internal data management, and the combined entity will serve over 16,000 enterprises.

The transaction has been unanimously approved by Varonis’s board and is expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending shareholder and regulatory approvals. Until closing, the two companies will operate independently, and Varonis will delist from Nasdaq after the deal. Proofpoint’s investor Thoma Bravo will provide equity financing and has secured debt‑financing commitments; the Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan has also agreed to invest in Proofpoint as part of the transaction.

items.title: 摩根士丹利發出最新警告：記憶體股低本益比恐為周期頂峰「估值陷阱」
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Issues New Warning: Low P/E Ratios in Memory Stocks May Signal a Cycle‑Peak Valuation Trap
paras: 在人工智慧(AI)強勁需求的推升下，全球記憶體晶片產業正經歷前所未有的超級周期。然而，摩根士丹利分析師 Shawn Kim 在近期研報《記憶體：周期與超級周期》(Memory – Cycles vs. Super Cycles)中發出警告，指出儘管 AI 驅動的榮景屬實，但「最容易賺的錢已經過去」。
報告特別提醒投資人，記憶體股票往往恰恰在周期頂峰時看起來最便宜，目前的低本益比恐怕隱含著危險的估值陷阱。

低本益比隱含風險

自 2025 年 9 月本輪周期啟動以來，亞洲記憶體股價已暴漲約 9 倍，市場對亞洲記憶體企業的每股盈餘(EPS)平均上修幅度高達 432%。目前三星電子與 SK 海力士預估本益比僅約 3.5 至 3.7 倍，美光(MU-US)約 6.1 倍，遠低於輝達(NVDA-US)的 17.8 倍與台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)的 23 倍。
對此，Kim 測算，若要支撐當前股價繼續大幅上漲，DRAM 合約價需在現有水準上實現月率上漲約 70% 的極高門檻，這在現實中極難達成。相比之下，研調機構 TrendForce 預估 2026 年第四季傳統 DRAM 合約季增(QoQ)約 10% 至 15%。
摩根士丹利回顧 2008 年、2012 年與 2018 年的歷史數據警告，記憶體股價拐點通常會比企業盈餘頂峰提前 4 至 8 個月出現，市場習慣將高盈餘過度外推，導致本益比最低時反而最危險。

超級周期基本面強勁

儘管對股價前景趨於謹慎，報告並未否認當前強勁的基本面。三星電子在 2026 年第三季創下高達 800 億美元的營業利潤，刷新科技業歷史紀錄；高頻寬記憶體(HBM)市場規模預計於 2028 年翻三倍至 1,000 億美元。台灣廠商南亞科(2408-TW)9 月營收年率大增 576.62%。
然而，高額利潤促使各大晶圓廠大幅增加資本支出，預計 2026 年 DRAM 資本支出將年增 82% 至 980 億美元，2027 年更將進一步增至 1,500 億至 1,600 億美元。隨著中國記憶體廠商長鑫存儲(CXMT)與長江存儲(YMTC)快速擴產，以及新建產能預計於 2027 年下半年逐步釋放，產業供需失衡的局面恐被反轉。

摩根士丹利重塑投資優先順序

報告進一步分析，隨著 AI 資料中心規模擴大，硬體系統的價值分配正在發生變化。以輝達 NVL72 系統為例，當單機架擴展至 8 機架互聯時，記憶體佔系統價值的比重由 29% 降至 19%，而網路設備的比重則由 10% 提升至 20%。
基於此結構性轉移，Kim 建議將 AI 產業鏈的投資偏好重新排序為：AI 算力第一、網路設備第二、記憶體晶片第三，並對面臨成本高企與產能過剩風險的下游硬體持最保守態度。近期如 SK 海力士與三星股價單日重挫逾 8% 至 9%、日本鎧俠(Kioxia)較高點回檔約 58.6%，均顯示市場已開始重新評估周期風險。
paras_en: Driven by strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI), the global memory‑chip industry is undergoing an unprecedented super‑cycle. However, Morgan Stanley analyst Shawn Kim warned in a recent research note, “Memory: Cycles vs. Super Cycles,” that although the AI‑driven boom is real, “the easiest money has already been made.”
The report specifically cautions investors that memory stocks often appear cheapest precisely at the peak of a cycle, and today’s low price‑to‑earnings ratios may hide a dangerous valuation trap.

Low P/E risk Since the current cycle began in September 2025, Asian memory stocks have surged roughly nine‑fold, with the market revising earnings per share (EPS) forecasts for Asian memory firms upward by an average of 432%. Samsung and SK Hynix now project P/E ratios of only about 3.5‑3.7 times, while Micron (MU‑US) is around 6.1 times—far below Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) 17.8 times and TSMC’s (2330‑TW)(TSM‑US) 23 times.

Kim estimates that to sustain the present steep price gains, DRAM contract prices would need to rise about 70% month‑over‑month from current levels—a threshold that is extremely hard to achieve in reality. By contrast, research firm TrendForce forecasts traditional DRAM contract quarterly growth of roughly 10%‑15% in Q4 2026.

Morgan Stanley reviewed historical data from 2008, 2012 and 2018 and warned that memory‑stock inflection points typically occur 4‑8 months before earnings peaks. The market’s habit of over‑projecting high earnings makes the lowest P/E ratios the most hazardous.

Super‑cycle fundamentals remain strong Despite a more cautious outlook for stock prices, the report does not deny the strong fundamentals. Samsung posted a record‑high operating profit of $80 billion in Q3 2026, a tech‑industry record; the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) market is expected to triple to $100 billion by 2028. Taiwan’s Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) saw September revenue jump 576.62% year‑over‑year.

However, the hefty profits are prompting wafer fabs to sharply increase capital spending, with DRAM capex projected to rise 82% to $98 billion in 2026 and further to $150‑$160 billion in 2027. Rapid expansion by China’s CXMT and YMTC, together with new capacity slated for gradual release in the second half of 2027, could reverse the current supply‑demand imbalance.

Morgan Stanley reshapes investment priorities The note further analyzes that as AI data‑center scale expands, the value allocation within hardware systems is shifting. Using Nvidia’s NVL72 system as an example, when a single rack scales to an eight‑rack interconnect, memory’s share of system value falls from 29% to 19%, while networking equipment’s share rises from 10% to 20%.

Based on this structural shift, Kim recommends re‑ranking AI‑industry‑chain investment preferences to: AI compute first, networking equipment second, memory chips third, and taking the most conservative stance toward downstream hardware facing high costs and overcapacity risks. Recent single‑day drops of over 8%‑9% in SK Hynix and Samsung shares, and Kioxia’s roughly 58.6% pullback from its highs, both signal the market is beginning to reassess cycle risks.

items.title_en: Baron Analysis: Why Nvidia Is Relatively Resilient Amid AI Debt Concerns Sparking Semiconductor Stock Selling Pressure
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 週五（16日）股價雖然仍承受賣壓，但相較之下展現出一定韌性；與此同時，其他半導體類股持續遭到拋售，跌勢已演變成該產業十多年來最嚴重的賣壓之一。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，輝達週四（15日）下跌 1.8% 後，週五盤前股價在平盤下方徘徊，此前一度上漲近 1%。自 10 月 6 日以來，輝達股價已下跌 9%。
追蹤半導體類股的安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 自 10 月 6 日以來已連續 8 個交易日下跌，創 2015 年 9 月以來最長連跌紀錄。週五開盤前，安碩半導體ETF下跌 0.4%，可能將連跌紀錄延長至 9 個交易日。盤中，安碩半導體ETF則下跌1.41%。
近幾日，隨著市場對 AI 擴建所需債務不斷增加的疑慮升高，進一步加劇半導體類股的跌勢，其中雲端運算業者 CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 尤其受到關注。
不過，輝達執行長黃仁勳週四表示，輝達不需要為 CoreWeave 提供財務擔保，緩解投資人疑慮，帶動輝達股價自當日低點反彈。輝達同時是 CoreWeave 的供應商、客戶與投資人。
週五盤前，輝達的反彈似乎有加速跡象，而截稿前，輝達週五盤中下跌0.50%。相較之下，同業超微半導體(AMD-US) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 盤前均下跌逾 1%。盤中，超微半導體下跌3.27%，英特爾則下跌2.06%。
針對輝達股價為何相對抗跌，《巴隆》指出其中一個原因可能是，經歷一段時間的持續下跌後，輝達股價對投資人而言已變得更具吸引力。
輝達是全球市值最高的上市公司，也是近年 AI 投資熱潮中最受青睞的股票之一，而技術指標也提供了相關線索。
在近期跌勢中，輝達股價於 10 月 6 日跌破 50 日與 200 日簡單移動平均線（SMA），此後大多時間都在這兩個傳統技術支撐水準下方徘徊。
週四交易期間，輝達股價一度跌至 213 美元，當時 50 日均線約為 220 美元，200 日均線則約為 224 美元。
黃仁勳發表談話後，股價反彈，與 50 日均線的差距明顯縮小，來到 217.23 美元，僅略低於 217.37 美元的 50 日均線。若反彈走勢延續至週五，技術指標將開始呈現更為看漲的訊號。
從基本面來看，黃仁勳的安撫性談話，很可能也讓原本擔心輝達在整體 AI 產業債務風險中所處位置的投資人稍感安心。
這或許足以支撐輝達自身股價，但黃仁勳能否進一步提振市場信心、帶動整個半導體產業止跌，並阻止賣壓持續擴大，仍有待觀察。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) saw its share price still under selling pressure on Friday (the 16th), but it showed a degree of resilience; at the same time, other semiconductor stocks continued to be sold off, with the decline becoming one of the worst in the sector in more than a decade.

According to Barron's, Nvidia fell 1.8% on Thursday (the 15th) and traded below the flat line in pre‑market trading on Friday after briefly rallying nearly 1%. Since October 6, Nvidia’s stock has dropped 9%.

The SOXX semiconductor ETF, which tracks semiconductor stocks, has fallen for eight consecutive trading days since October 6, setting the longest losing streak since September 2015. Ahead of Friday’s open, the ETF was down 0.4%, potentially extending the streak to nine days, and it fell 1.41% during the session.

In recent days, growing market worries about the mounting debt needed to expand AI capacity have further intensified the sell‑off in semiconductor stocks, with cloud‑computing provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) drawing particular attention.

However, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said on Thursday that Nvidia does not need to provide financial guarantees for CoreWeave, easing investor concerns and prompting Nvidia’s shares to rebound from the day’s low. Nvidia is also a supplier, customer and investor in CoreWeave.

In pre‑market trading on Friday, Nvidia’s rebound appeared to accelerate, but by the time of publication the stock was down 0.50% during Friday’s session. By contrast, peers AMD (AMD-US) and Intel (INTC-US) were both down more than 1% in pre‑market trading, with AMD falling 3.27% and Intel 2.06% during the day.
Barron noted that one reason Nvidia’s stock is holding up better is that, after a prolonged decline, its price has become more attractive to investors.
Nvidia is the world’s largest‑valued public company and one of the most favored stocks in the recent AI investment boom, and technical indicators also provide clues.
During the recent decline, Nvidia’s price fell below its 50‑day and 200‑day simple moving averages on October 6 and has spent most of the time since then below these traditional support levels.
During Thursday’s trading, Nvidia’s price briefly dropped to $213, while the 50‑day moving average was around $220 and the 200‑day average about $224.

After Huang’s remarks, the stock rebounded, narrowing the gap to the 50‑day average to $217.23, just below the $217.37 50‑day line. If the rebound continues into Friday, the technical indicators could turn more bullish.
From a fundamentals perspective, Huang’s reassuring comments likely eased investors’ worries about Nvidia’s exposure to overall AI‑industry debt risk.

Whether this support is enough to sustain Nvidia’s own share price, and whether Huang can further boost market confidence, halt the broader semiconductor decline and curb the expanding sell pressure, remains to be seen.

items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Weakens While Stocks Hold, Falling 0.73 ¢ to Slip Below the 32.3 TWD Mark
paras: 在美元指數維持強勢、外資持續撤出亞洲市場影響下，新台幣兌美元今 (16) 日走弱，終場收在32.338元，貶值7.3分，續創近期波段低點，顯示國際資金仍偏向美元資產，相較於昨天的91億美元爆巨量，台北外匯經紀公司與元太外匯經紀公司合計總成交量為 46.12億美元。
儘管匯市承壓，台股表現相對有撐，加權指數終場收在47,111點，上漲141點，漲幅約0.3%，呈現匯弱股強格局。市場買盤主要聚焦 AI 伺服器、高階 PCB 及半導體供應鏈族群，在電子權值股支撐下，大盤成功守住漲勢。
從籌碼面來看，統計今日三大法人合計賣超約729億元，其中外資賣超高達494億元，已連續第8個交易日站在賣方；投信則持續扮演護盤角色，買超約132億元，寫下連6買；自營商賣超約367億元。
市場人士指出，本波新台幣轉弱主要受到美元升值效應帶動，近期美國經濟數據維持韌性，加上市場重新評估聯準會後續政策路徑，推升美元買盤，亞洲主要貨幣同步承壓，新台幣也不例外。資料顯示，10月以來新台幣已由31字頭一路走貶至32.3元以上水準。
觀察資金流向，外資近期持續調節台股權值股與電子類股部位，成為匯市與股市的重要變數。不過投信買盤明顯進場承接，加上AI相關產業基本面未見轉弱，因此支撐台股維持高檔震盪格局。今天市場呈現「匯率偏空、股市偏多」，除外資匯出導致台幣走弱，加上AI、高效能運算(HPC)及先進封裝需求仍強，吸引國內資金與長線買盤進駐，使台股維持相對強勢。
paras_en: Under a strong US dollar index and continued foreign‑capital outflows from Asian markets, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar today (Oct 16), closing at 32.338 TWD, down 0.73 ¢ and extending its recent low‑point swing, indicating that international funds remain biased toward dollar assets. In contrast to yesterday’s massive USD 91 billion turnover, Taipei’s foreign‑exchange brokers and Yuan‑Tai FX brokers together handled a total volume of USD 46.12 billion.

Despite pressure on the currency market, Taiwan’s equity market showed relative resilience, with the weighted index closing at 47,111 points, up 141 points or about 0.3%, reflecting a “weak currency, strong stocks” pattern. Buying interest centered on AI servers, high‑end PCBs and semiconductor supply‑chain groups, and the rally in heavyweight electronics stocks helped the market maintain its upward momentum.

From a flow perspective, the three major institutional investors sold a combined net NT$729 billion today, with foreign investors leading the sell‑side at NT$494 billion for the eighth consecutive trading day. Trust funds continued to play a stabilising role, net‑buying about NT$132 billion for the sixth straight session, while proprietary traders sold roughly NT$367 billion.

Market observers said the recent weakening of the Taiwan dollar is mainly driven by the dollar’s appreciation. Recent US economic data remain resilient and the market’s reassessment of the Fed’s policy path has boosted dollar demand, putting pressure on major Asian currencies, including the TWD. Data show that since October the Taiwan dollar has slid from the low‑31s to above the 32.3 TWD level.

Looking at capital flows, foreign investors have been adjusting their positions in Taiwan’s heavyweight and electronics stocks, becoming a key variable for both the FX and equity markets. However, trust‑fund buying is evident, and the fundamentals of AI‑related industries have not weakened, supporting the Taiwan stock market’s high‑level range‑bound pattern. Today’s market displayed a “bearish currency, bullish equity” stance: foreign outflows weakened the TWD, while strong demand for AI, high‑performance computing and advanced packaging kept domestic and long‑term buying interest in equities, allowing the stock market to stay relatively strong.
